notes.title: Status Update 1st September 2016
notes.notes:
Howdy hunters,

Welcome to our status update. The work on the new reserve (and the new animals) continues. Our epic Summer Fiesta event is over and you can find the final leaderboards here. Thank you all, let’s do it again next year, until then we’ll make sure that you have plenty other things to do.

Yesterday we released a patch in which we increased the limit of world items. Now you can place 8 tents, 7 deployable hunting towers and 15 tripods, blinds or tree stands, per reserve. We are currently also running a sale on the large equipment in the store, so be sure to take advantage and stock up.

Another big (and sad) piece of news is that this is the last week at Expansive Worlds for our game designer Daniel, so I have asked him to reply to some questions about the design of the new reserve, enjoy!

http://news.thehunter.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/09/ruinedtrapperhutinforest.png

Behind-the-scenes – Game design

http://news.thehunter.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/11/IMG_20151120_102123-e1448028705100.jpgQ: Why a reserve based on the Rockies in the first place?

A: It was very much requested by our players and the entire team got excited by the dramatic landscapes that a Rockies based map could offer.

Q: Is there going to be something unique about this reserve? What would make it special, in comparison to the others?

A: It is our first fall map based on a North American environment. It also features quite lot of exploration opportunities, more than any other map we’ve done before. Added to this is a handful of new species to hunt!

Q: What species are going to live there and can you shed some light on why you chose those specific ones?

A: Well, we always try to add animals that make sense in that particular environment but also glance at what the community wants. When we started with ptarmigans we were already working on the new reserve, so we decided to add the White-tailed Ptarmigan to the lineup. There will also be Bighorn Sheep to keep the White-tailed Ptarmigans company up in the mountains. We know there are a lot of people who want to more goats and sheep in theHunter so that decision was an easy one. The Rocky Mountain Elk was also an easy decision since we know people like to hunt Elk. Then we needed something iconic for the reserve and the vote fell on perhaps the most iconic North American big game animal around. The Grizzly Bear. It also felt like it was time to give the good old Mule Deer somewhere new to hang out so they will roam the map as well.

Q: What excites you most about the upcoming reserve? What are you looking forward to the most?

A: The environments are simply stunning! But I also look forward to something unannounced that will be added to reserve a little bit later after the initial release…

http://news.thehunter.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/09/mining_place.png

Q: Can you rank theHunter reserves from your most favourite and least favourite? Where do you think the Rockies will fall?

A: I think it has the potential to become my favorite reserve. It’s like a combo of Hirschfelden and Redfeather Falls with some Settler Creeks and Val-des-Bois sprinkled on top!

Q: Since it’s your last week at Expansive Worlds, is there something you’d like to share with the community? Some yet unrevealed secrets or your personal highlights? Start pouring out of your bottomless well of wisdom!

A: 1: Eat your greens. 2: Never accept subpar beer. 3: Listen to the community. Oh and 4: The Mallard Missions are based on fact based factual facts.

That’s it from us for today!

Happy hunting!

notes.title: Status Update 25th August 2016
notes.notes:
Howdy hunters,

Time for our weekly status update! Have we got good news for you? Sure we have. So grab a cold one, sit back and indulge.

For one, after some additional tweaking and polishing we finally felt that our willow ptarmigans were ready to be released onto Hemmeldal, so we did so yesterday and a little bird told me they are tons of fun. For some willow ptarmigan action, make sure to pop by our official Twitch channel today at 16:00 CEST to catch the latest Lock&Learn 😉

http://news.thehunter.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/08/SplashScreen_ptarmigan_willow.png

Secondly, and it fills my heart with pure joy to tell you this, our brilliant character artist Ami and equally brilliant animator Morris have started working on upgrading our brown and black bears. Those poor guys have been admittedly our worst offenders among theHunter beasts when it comes to model and animations and the team are super thrilled to finally be able to give them some well-deserved love. I for one can’t wait to see the final result, having said that there is no ETA on when the upgraded bears will be released, so please bear with the existing ones for a bit longer 😉

A bit more on the things in progress. We are aware that the tracking is a bit broken right now and are working on it. Next week we are planning to present a delicious patch with fixes and of course some new stuff, so make sure to be there when we spill the beans.

The last animal for the Summer Fiesta competition is here and it’s a Blacktail Deer. Yes, we are that sneaky. So, if you’ve been mindful with your attempts, like we urged you to be, you can still turn things around in the remaining 4 days of the competition. Good luck to you all and may the best hunters win!

Tomorrow we are launching a little sweet GIF competition on our Twitter channel for you to unleash your theHunter creativity. Keep your eyes peeled for an announcement tomorrow for a chance to get some action and win some prizes.

And finally, what many of you have been patiently waiting for in the last week since the announcement of the Rockies – work-in-progress screenshots! Our artist Mattias has kindly responded to your pleas and snapped a couple of good ones for you. I’ll just leave them here and let you savour all the luminescent beauty.

notes.title: Status Update 17th August 2016
notes.notes:
Howdy hunters,

Here’s what’s been happening around here.

I’ve seen it rainin fire in the sky…

In the last status update we planted some seeds about the new reserve in the works and many of you have been spot on with your guesses. It’s a Rocky Mountains inspired reserve with fall environment, whoop whoop! The Rockies have consistently ended up high in our player surveys, as you can see from the snapshots of the results of our 2015 and 2016 surveys below (click to enlarge; some reserve options are of course hidden, but your collective opinion regarding those is duly noted).
http://news.thehunter.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/08/2015.png
Survey results 2015
http://news.thehunter.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/08/2016.png
Survey results 2016

Game design competition – winners announced

We’ve finally had a chance to read through the latest mission and competition submissions and the results are in! In the mission category our game designer Daniel praised the missions by Tanngnjostr for their fun and personality. In the competition category it has been a tight race between three contenders and the winner has been picked only a couple of hours ago. Congratulations to mdfortney! The two runners-up are were waiora and MonacoSteve, whose sets Daniel also liked a lot but some components of them are unfortunately not really implementable with our current competition system. The winners will receive 5000 em$, the Almost Dev Jacket alongside the honourable Contributor rank, and the runners-up will each receive 2000 em$. You can find the winning designs here.

http://news.thehunter.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/07/SplashScreen_create_duck.png

The winning missions and competitions will be implemented in theHunter as soon as they are set up and tested. If your design was not picked this time, please don’t despair, we have lots of new animals coming up!

On the cable-backed bow

http://news.thehunter.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/08/SplashScreen_weapon_cablebackbow.pngFollowing the release of the cable-backed bow we’ve been collecting your feedback and sentiments and felt that a short explanation from our game designer might be appropriate. The bow got a lot of critique due to it being too weak. These bows are not so powerful in real life and this is why it was kept at the lower end of the power spectrum. We have now increased it a bit, making it resemble a bow made of modern materials more than traditional materials. However, the cable-backed bow is still primarily to be used at distances of up to 30, perhaps 40 meters. Beyond that range it will lose power quite dramatically. That is, until gravity increases the force of the arrow again. On the way down, the speed of an arrow may increase slightly due to the gravitational pull. Pulling off shots like that is quite difficult but the expert archers out there keep on impressing us with their near impossible long range harvests.

Welcome new recruits!

Since the introduction of the new Recruit a Friend programme, oodles of new people have joined us by invitation of their friends, welcome guys! Many a Moose have been killed and many, many camping supplies, membership days and special items have been added to the recruiters. If you want to see the coveted .308 Engraved Bolt-Action Rifle in action, check out this video by HooCairs. We’re happy to see that you’ve been making use of this programme and hope to see more of your friends joining the troops of the EHR.

Say Ciao to Roberto!

A while ago we told you that our brave soldier Danny left his honourable post as the lead client programmer at theHunter to pursue his dreams overseas, and today we are happy to present his replacement, straight from Italy! Roberto will lead our client programming team, represented by Carl-Oscar, Patrick and Robin. Get to know him via his intro below and say hello!

http://news.thehunter.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/08/Roberto.jpg

Hi everyone! My name is Roberto Mangiafico and I’ve just joined the incredible theHunter team as Lead Programmer.

I moved to Stockholm from Italy facing the great Swedish winter to follow my passion for develop and play great games. I’ve started my career in the game industry in 2007 as programmer in Ubisoft, then in 2011 I left to create my own company Bad Seed and now I made a big step forward joining Avalanche and theHunter team!

I’m an avid player, game lover and technology addict and when I don’t play videogames I follow my other passions and do snowboarding, play volleyball and read manga!

See you in the forum and in the woods for a great hunt!

notes.title: Status Update 17th August 2016
notes.notes:
Howdy hunters,

Here’s what’s been happening around here.

I’ve seen it rainin fire in the sky…

In the last status update we planted some seeds about the new reserve in the works and many of you have been spot on with your guesses. It’s a Rocky Mountains inspired reserve with fall environment, whoop whoop! The Rockies have consistently ended up high in our player surveys, as you can see from the snapshots of the results of our 2015 and 2016 surveys below (click to enlarge; some reserve options are of course hidden, but your collective opinion regarding those is duly noted).
http://news.thehunter.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/08/2015.png
Survey results 2015
http://news.thehunter.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/08/2016.png
Survey results 2016

Game design competition – winners announced

We’ve finally had a chance to read through the latest mission and competition submissions and the results are in! In the mission category our game designer Daniel praised the missions by Tanngnjostr for their fun and personality. In the competition category it has been a tight race between three contenders and the winner has been picked only a couple of hours ago. Congratulations to mdfortney! The two runners-up are were waiora and MonacoSteve, whose sets Daniel also liked a lot but some components of them are unfortunately not really implementable with our current competition system. The winners will receive 5000 em$, the Almost Dev Jacket alongside the honourable Contributor rank, and the runners-up will each receive 2000 em$. You can find the winning designs here.

http://news.thehunter.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/07/SplashScreen_create_duck.png

The winning missions and competitions will be implemented in theHunter as soon as they are set up and tested. If your design was not picked this time, please don’t despair, we have lots of new animals coming up!

On the cable-backed bow

http://news.thehunter.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/08/SplashScreen_weapon_cablebackbow.pngFollowing the release of the cable-backed bow we’ve been collecting your feedback and sentiments and felt that a short explanation from our game designer might be appropriate. The bow got a lot of critique due to it being too weak. These bows are not so powerful in real life and this is why it was kept at the lower end of the power spectrum. We have now increased it a bit, making it resemble a bow made of modern materials more than traditional materials. However, the cable-backed bow is still primarily to be used at distances of up to 30, perhaps 40 meters. Beyond that range it will lose power quite dramatically. That is, until gravity increases the force of the arrow again. On the way down, the speed of an arrow may increase slightly due to the gravitational pull. Pulling off shots like that is quite difficult but the expert archers out there keep on impressing us with their near impossible long range harvests.

notes.title: Status Update 11th August 2016
notes.notes:
Hello hunters,

Time for another status update from us. If you missed the game update from yesterday, alongside some fixes and changes we’ve also added leaderboards and achievements for Polar Bear, following your unambiguous feedback. Hope you’ll enjoy hunting in the northern regions of WHiterime Ridge even more now.

As for the big news I promised you last week, yes,  it IS a new reserve we are working on! We released Whiterime Ridge in autumn last year and it’s time to bring new hunting experiences to your game. (What needs to be said here is that our Whiterime Ridge release was very turbulent, it was a harsh lesson for us and will do everything possible not to repeat our mistakes.) For now we can only tell you that this one is going to be the biggest reserve in theHunter and our artists have been focusing on creating lots of amazing vista opportunities. If you’ve been with us long enough, you know that a new location is a month-long work with tons of things needing to fall into places before it’s a product ready to be shown. So, from now on we’ll be slowly revealing some bits and pieces of the upcoming location, but let the speculation commence 😉

And now onto another big piece of news for today, which is…

Introducing the new Recruit a Friend

We’ve always seen theHunter as the ultimate game for creating and nurturing strong bonds between people. Nothing makes us happier than seeing players from different parts of the world becoming friends for life, and real life friends and couples having fun in the EHR together. Because let’s face it, what else could make a friendship stronger than stalking a monster Brown Bear together for half an hour through the chilly hills of Hemmeldal, finally getting that big boy and posing for a memory trophy shot? Not much, in my book.

http://news.thehunter.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/08/brownbear_alenacb.jpg

To motivate you to invite your friends to theHunter, we’ve had a Recruit a Friend programme. It has existed for a couple of years and although many of you have taken advantage of it, we felt that the programme has been lacking something.

So, we took a closer look at our Recruit a Friend system and decided to ramp it up a notch. Not only have we added more rewards to recruiters if the invited party buys a membership (including some exclusive items that are not possible to acquire otherwise), but we also put together a nice welcome package to people who joined by invitation, so they can get started hunting right away!

Rewards for Recruiters
http://news.thehunter.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/08/SplashScreen_Template_reqruit_a_friend3.png
If the friend you’ve invited to theHunter buys a 3 month membership or Wayfarer bundle, you will get 10 days added to your membership, Camping Supplies (15 Pack) and a spiffing new  Deer “Grunt” Call – Carved Wood (one time reward) for your deer hunting adventures together.If the friend you’ve invited to theHunter buys a 6 month membership or Pathfinder bundle, you will get 20 days added to your membership, Camping Supplies (50 Pack) and a Two Person Tree stand – Forest Camo mesh (one time reward) for super concealment of you and your bud.f the friend you’ve invited to theHunter buys a 12 month membership or Trailrunner bundle, you will get 30 days added to your membership, Camping Supplies (100 Pack) and a stunning .308 Bolt Action Rifle – Engraved (one time reward)!
Rewards for Recruits:

All friends will sign up for theHunter using your referral link will immediately receive 200 em$, a 5x30mm Rangefinder, a Moose caller, and a large Scent eliminator! Whoop whoop!

Please note:
You will only receive rewards if your friend signs up for theHunter using your unique referral link which you can find here.One time rewards will not be added retrospectively to people being invited and registering before August 10, 2016.Retail memberships (DVD) do not count toward referrals.
Happy hunting with your friends!

notes.title: Status Update 5th August 2016
notes.notes:
Hello hunters,

Time for a short status update from the EW headquarters.

Summer Fiesta

http://news.thehunter.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/07/SplashScreen_summerfiesta_main.pngThe Fiesta is gaining speed and volume as more and more animals are being added. This week Turkey and Coyote have joined the competition, with more animals to come. Important information for players competing – the rules have recently changed. Now the best score of all your harvests of each species counts towards your leaderboard result, not only of the first three as originally announced at the beginning. The reason for this change is that our system is currently not able to handle such a condition in multispecies competitions, which was, sadly, only discovered after the start of the Fiesta. The good thing is that the table is still open and you can improve your scores even for the first added species. Just be mindful of your attempts and be strategic. Good luck!

Also, starting from this week, it’s no longer possible to activate a competition while in the middle of a hunting session. This change was implemented to prevent people from manipulating the (previously) existing loophole, and gaining an unfair advantage in competitions.

Cable-backed Bow

http://news.thehunter.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/08/SplashScreen_weapon_cablebackbow.pngOn Wednesday we released a new weapon, probably the coolest-ever addition to our archery arsenal. The cable-backed bow. It’s a primitive weapon inspired by the bows made by native people of America. It’s not our easiest weapon to handle and certainly takes some practice to get the knack of it but placing that perfect shot from this sophisticated bow is so much rewarding and enjoyable. Well, try it yourself if you want to experience something different.

Duck Game Design Competition

http://news.thehunter.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/07/SplashScreen_create_duck.pngFinally, a small reminder that the deadline of our game design competition is approaching. You have three days left to come up with a great mission or competition pack and write your name in the chronicles of theHunter forever. You can find the details here.

That’s it from us for today. Next week we’ll have more news to tell about the new big thing in the making as well as a game patch with something new, and fixes for something old. For now, enjoy the weekend and see you out there in the EHR woods!

notes.title: Status Update 28th July 2016
notes.notes:
Hello hunters,

Welcome to our weekly status update!

Birds of a feather

If you missed our game update earlier today, we’ve just released a flock of Rock Ptarmigans onto the mountainous regions of Val-des-Bois where the birds will join the previously solitary Alpine Ibex. The ptarmigans will surely remind you of Pheasants, since they are distant relatives, but they also have some distinctive features as well. For one, they are more social and thus prefer to hang out in larger families. In addition, they have an excellent camo and blend with the environment exclusively, so spotting them won’t be easy. I shall let you find out the rest by yourselves 😉

http://news.thehunter.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/07/rock_ptarmigan.png

To help make the search for Ptarmigans easier, we’ll add 40 free units of climbing gear to every player’s inventory who starts a hunting session between today and the end of Monday, August 1st (CEST). Go crazy on those ridges and don’t forget your medkits.

“What about the Willow Ptarmigans?” I hear you ask. We are still working on those little ones. There are some small issues to be ironed out before we are 100% satisfied with their quality and performance. You may come across some traces of their presence on the website, such as achievements, but we’ll make a proper announcement once they are officially released.

Summer Fiesta firing up

http://news.thehunter.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/07/SplashScreen_summerfiesta_missions1.png

On Monday we kicked off our traditional Summer Fiesta. Lots of challenging missions, a competition with a new format and, of course, sales, trophies and prizes. Tons of hunting fun to add some thrill and excitement to your month of August 😉

A few people have already completed all the missions, woop woop! So we’ll see whether Doc will need to step in again and stir the things up a bit. Today the new animal entered the competition, and I hope you’ve been using your attempts sparingly, since there will be lots of jokers later on 😉

You can find the description and discussion of this event in this forum thread.

Community design competition #2

http://news.thehunter.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/07/SplashScreen_create_duck1.png

It’s time for the second part of our hugely successful game design competition. There are still three species missing their specific challenges and we are calling for your imagination and game knowledge! It will be a bit different this time, as your task will be to create a set of missions or competitions for all fours duck species. Mallard, American Black Duck, Northern Pintail and Gadwall. The rules can be found in this forum thread and you will have ten days to submit your design for a chance to win 5,000 em$ / 90 membership days, a very special Contributor membership (that will remain with you for the rest of your life in theHunter) and an exclusive “Almost DEV” jacket!

Happy hunting!

notes.title: Game Update 21st July 2016
notes.notes:
Hello hunters,

It’s status update time!

It’s a birdie!

As we revealed during last week’s Lock&Learn, the new species coming to theHunter are Ptarmigans. Rock Ptarmigan will inhabit Val-des-Bois and Willow Ptarmigan will inhabit Hemmeldal. The two viewers who first guessed the species and subspecies during the livestream have been awarded their em$. Work on the birds is already in the final phase as we iron out some rough edges and polish a few minor things. We hope to be able to release these wonderful sounding critters on their respective habitats very soon. Until then, enjoy this sneak peek on these cool birdies.
http://news.thehunter.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/07/ptarmigan_screenshot2.png
Rock ptarmigan
http://news.thehunter.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/07/ptarmigan_screenshot1.png
Willow ptarmigan

Two-person tripod

https://static.thehunter.com/static/img/items/256/large_equipment_dual_tripod_01.pngYesterday we released another great piece of large equipment for players who love hunting with their friends. The two-person tripod. Perfect to call in an animal, get on top and pass the time chatting with your buddy while the animal makes its way to you. There is also a super crazy bundle in the store which features this new tripod. Check it out, it’s probably the biggest discount we’ve ever offered on relatively new stuff.

Bugs

Here’s an update on the recent bugs – disappearing climbing gear, messed up sounds and calls as well as reduced weapon steadiness on towers. We are aiming to patch fixes for all those locusts in the next game update, hopefully next week (subject to change). As always, stay tuned and follow our updates!

Summer Fiesta

What’s for sure happening next week is the return of our traditional and probably most loved summer event. That’s right, it’s time for another summer fiesta! This time we’ve come up with a slightly different format, and I think that everyone will find something that appeals. Check back at the beginning of next week to learn the details!

Killing season

http://news.thehunter.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/07/killing_season.jpg

In case you’ve missed this thread on the forum – check out this epic competition by community member caledonianblues, which starts August 22nd. Sign up now and use this time to hone your skills, devise your strategies and plan how you’re going to walk away with some of the enormous 100,000 em$ prize pool!

On a final note, due to the summer doldrums, our weekly stream Lock&Learn is going on vacations together with Johanna and will be back in a couple of weeks.

Happy hunting!

We are aiming to patch fixes for all those locusts in the next game update, hopefully next week (subject to change). As always, stay tuned and follow our updates!

Summer Fiesta

What’s for sure happening next week is the return of our traditional and probably most loved summer event. That’s right, it’s time for another summer fiesta! This time we’ve come up with a slightly different format, and I think that everyone will find something that appeals. Check back at the beginning of next week to learn the details!

Killing season

http://news.thehunter.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/07/killing_season.jpg

In case you’ve missed this thread on the forum – check out this epic competition by community member caledonianblues, which starts August 22nd. Sign up now and use this time to hone your skills, devise your strategies and plan how you’re going to walk away with some of the enormous 100,000 em$ prize pool!

On a final note, due to the summer doldrums, our weekly stream Lock&Learn is going on vacations together with Johanna and will be back in a couple of weeks.

Happy hunting!

notes.title: Status Update 14th July 2016
notes.notes:
Hello good hunters,

Welcome to our weekly status update!

Musings on game crashes

Starting with the big news, in case you missed it yesterday. We released a game patch which has been one of the most celebrated and welcomed game updates in the last months, both in theHunter team and the community. At least for people who were affected by repeated game crashes. In the patch we implemented the community-found and tested fix that we communicated in our last status update. The result is heart-warming and inspiring. Not only do we keep getting reports from people who have been plagued by those crashes that are able to play again with no problem after the patch, but we also see a huge drop in the numbers in our crash reporter tool.

Why just a drop and not a total elimination you ask? That is the million dollar question. The truth is that in any game, especially such an old and complex one like theHunter, with such an immense amount of content, there will always be crashes. Different combinations of software, hardware, actions performed in the game, Internet and server hiccups along with a host of other factors can cause the client to crash. The roots of those rare, random crashes are exceptionally difficult to locate. Although we are 100% committed to fixing as much as we can, especially when it comes to serious bugs and issues, we need to make our peace with the fact that the game will crash for some players once in awhile.

More bits and pieces about the patch

With the last game update we also included a fix for Sitka Deer that capped their antlers and made them too small. On your next hunt, drop by Whiterime Ridge to check them out and, while you are there, why not do some of the Sitka Deer missions created by Mills?

Continued bug fixing

Some known issues that we are looking into right now are disappearing climbing ropes on Val-des-Bois, Arctic Fox footstep sounds as well as weapon wobble on the towers. We are aiming to release a smaller patch with fixes for those very soon. Stay tuned!

Time for a new animal?

If you say so! While fixing stuff, we haven’t stopped working on new stuff for you to continuing experiencing theHunter as a constantly-evolving game. Yes, a new species is coming soon! Well, better to say, not one but two different species, which are variations, coming to two different reserves.

http://news.thehunter.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/07/splashscreen_lockandlearn9.png

Dying for a hint? I thought so. As we never like making it too easy for you, make sure to come and watch our Lock&Learn today at 16:00 CEST on our official Twitch channel. This time Johanna will be accompanied by our User Acquisition Manager, Sacha, who joined us a couple of months ago and is now taking his first steps into the EHR. They will be hunting on one of the reserves where one the (two) new subspecies will reside, while also dropping some hints on what it will be. To spice the things up, the first person to guess the species and announce it in the livestream chat will get 1500 em$ on the spot. Hope to see you there!

Hunt ‘em all in Hemmeldal!

http://news.thehunter.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/07/loadout-splash_slonez.png

We continue releasing bundles with community loadouts that won in our competition, and it’s now time for Hemmeldal’s “Hunt-em-all” loadout by SloNeZ. You can pick it up here at a pretty great 53% discount!

That’s it from us for today!

Happy hunting!

notes.title: Status Update 7th July 2016
notes.notes:
Howdy hunters,

Hope you are well on this glorious summer’s day. Here’s what has been happening at the Expansive Worlds’ Headquarters.

Game Crashes – Workaround Test

Here is some important information for those of you who have been experiencing issues causing the game client to crash. We’re hopefully starting to see some progress on the matter, thanks to the dedicated efforts of our awesome community members who’ve discovered and thoroughly tested the workaround. While we are testing it internally, you can try to implement it yourself following the instructions in this forum thread. Please read both the original post from caledonianblues as well as the post from our producer Philipp carefully, ask your questions and report your findings in that very same thread. We will be closely monitoring the data and once all testing is verified, we will build the solution and roll it out automatically for everyone.

Thanks again to our community members Pretty_Boy, Fletchette, caledonianblues and others who helped to test and roll this out to the larger community. You guys officially rock and we are humbled and honoured to have you playing with us! <3

Geek out on your hunting data!

http://news.thehunter.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/07/caledonianblues_lifetime_stats.jpg

Staying on the matter of impressive community efforts, make sure to check this sophisticated stats web app, developed by the aforementioned caledonianblues: http://www.uhcapps.co.uk/stats_lifetime.php?username=caledonianblues (just exchange “caledonianblues” in the URL to your own theHunter username to see your own stats). Search among your weapons, species, collectables, see some nice graphs of your hunting achievements and much, much more. Excellent work!

Semi-automatic wonderfulness

Yesterday we released another member of our semi-auto weapon family. The ultimate varmint equalizer, a .223 Semi-Automatic Rifle. From what we’ve gathered so far, the majority of you seem to like it, so that’s sweet! One of the common requests has been to expand the permitted species list by adding Sitka Deer (which by the way are getting a score upgrade in our next patch, don’t miss it). Our game designer Daniel is investigating this possibility, stay tuned for more news on this. If you want to see the rifle in all its glory, check out this video by our community member ronMctube:


Also, there is a nice bundle in the store right now with the new rifle, matching scope and a scent hound – have a look here.

Jambofinal is (almost) here

http://news.thehunter.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/06/SplashScreen_weapon_gold_bullpup.pngOur Football Jamboree 2016 is – alas – coming to an end. This Sunday is the last day when you can buy the “winning” t-shirt to secure that delightful 7mm Magnum Bullpup with gold engraving (it won’t be available in the store, ever), so place your bets and keep your fingers crossed for your favourite team to win. Following the requests from many players, we’re also releasing all the 32 national caps from theHunter Football Jamboree 2014. You can get them until the end of this week in our store.

New textures for old weapons

Recently we’ve been trying to show some love to our old content, and as part of this attempt we’ve given facelift and slight remodeling to our oldest (and arguably the least prettiest) rifles, the .243, .270 (wood), and .300 (composite) Bolt-Action Rifles. Go and check them in game to see the difference!

Happy hunting!

notes.title: Game Update 23rd June 2016
notes.notes:
http://news.thehunter.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/06/2014_happy_midsummer.jpgHowdy hunters,

The summer is here, the short time when it’s actually bearable to be in Sweden 😀 The EW team members are slowly drifting off to their vacations and it’s getting quieter in the office. Having said that, the work on developing and improving theHunter continues. Earlier today we released a patch with fixes and a GPS pin for your dogs and you can find a technical update from our producer Philipp about our ongoing work and plans below.

Tomorrow it’s the big holiday of Midsummer in this part of the world, during which the whole Sweden will be drinking spicy snaps and eating strawberries in the midnight sun. To celebrate it theHunter style, we are throwing in a weekend membership sale, so you can renew your membership at up to 30% off. Check the image below for the codes and please note that the sale runs until Monday, June 27th. There are also some great weekend discounts on duck equipment and weapons, up to 50% off – check them out.

http://news.thehunter.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/06/SplashScreen_membership_sale_june2016.png
Game Improvements Update

Hello Hunters,

with the continuing work on game improvements, we want to update you about our efforts, what has been done since the last announcement and what is to come.

This time we are taking a more general look at both server / database and also gameplay improvements. The goal is to get to the next level in terms of communication for game improvements and to give you a better overview about what is being worked on instead of repeating ourselves that game health is the main priority for us.

Improvements for server stability

Calle and Emil are monitoring our performance and stability around the clock, looking for slow and stressful processes and queries. After identifying the main offender, they released a major update to how the inventory system responds and is updated yesterday. There are no perceivable changes for players but we hope to improve stability and connectivity significantly. Releasing a fix is of course only the first step so we will collect data over the next days and then decide how to move on.

In the meantime they look for the next biggest offender, rinse and repeat and also help the client programmer by improving our crash reporter to be more detailed which helps us to prioritize what to fix next.

Next to that we are working on a bigger plan to relieve our database making better use of the Google service that we use. We might share the details of this in the next update or a later one.

Improvements for gameplay

Our client programmers have not been lazy either. After releasing the Scent Hound, they fixed several random crashes that slipped our testing and analyzed the main problems (crashes, bugs) we currently face in-depth.

We can’t share any specifics yet but we have our eyes mostly on graphical performance and memory, user interface and system memory used by sounds.

While we work on solutions for this (which will be shared in the next update or a later one) we released a patch today with fixes for Turkey and Pheasant scoring issues.

We hope this gives you a better impression of what we are working on and of the improvements to come. Stay tuned for the next updates as we share more specifics, fixes and the plans how to tackle what is left to do.

All the best and good hunting,

Your Phil and the rest of theHunter team

notes.title: Status Update - 17th June 2016
notes.notes:
Hello hunters,

Time for another status update from Expansive Worlds.

Server update

Many of you experienced interruptions and disturbed game performance on Tuesday, Wednesday and for a short time on Thursday. Our servers had been up and down due to our database responding to queries slower than usual. Our backend guys have been all hands on deck in the last days, streamlining queries and making the whole server-database communication more efficient. We are also working together with our server provider Google on getting to the bottom of the issue and at the same time improving the database performance. Our sincere apologies to everyone affected. Due to the service disruptions this week there was no new content released, but we are planning to resume the usual flow as soon as we can.

Additional attempts and new season

Since many of you have lost attempts in the Actual Football Event competition, we’ve added 10 additional ones. Also, as you might have noticed, the new 20th season started today. From now on, we are planning to make the season change more often and regular, you can expect to hear more details on this later.

Jamboree update

http://news.thehunter.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/06/SplashScreen_jamboree2016_changabletext_2.png

The Football Jamboree event is in full bloom. Don’t forget to buy the t-shirts before June 22nd, at the lowest possible price of 120 em$. The prices will double on June 23rd as we enter the Round of 16, so act fast. Also, today is the last day to get the bundle with all 24 T-Shirts at a super price. That Golden Bullpup is not going to win itself!

Lock & Learn

Yesterday Johanna was joined by our community member and a real Turkey connoisseur JackRbbt in pursuit after her first Turkey, notorious for being one of the trickiest species to hunt in theHunter. You can catch the recap of the livestream below. Please note that next week there will be no Lock&Learn due to the Swedish Midsummer, but if you want to join Johanna on one of her future streams – give her a shout!

Watch the recap

Spot on HunterTalk

http://news.thehunter.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/06/HutnerTalk1.png

And finally, we wanted to share with you some news about our German community HunterTalk. It’s one of our oldest non-English communities and it’s still holding strong. The HunterTalk staff have recently made amazing work moving the forum onto a new platform and it looks great. Together with the new platform, new events, functions and tools were added. For our German speaking players, you can find more details in this post from the HunterTalk admin M9Chis. Waidmannsheil!

That’s it from us for today.

Happy hunting!

notes.title: Status Update 9th June 2016
notes.notes:
Howdy hunters,

Our weekly status update is back after a short break due to the action-packed dog release. Here’s what we’ve been up to.

Scent Hounds

http://news.thehunter.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/06/pasted_image_at_2016_05_31_03_55_pm_1.png

For one, the scent hound release went really well and the whole team were super happy to read your comments showing that most people loved their new dogs and enjoyed their functionality. We have learned a lot from our first dogs, the retrievers, as well as excellent testing by our closed beta team which delivered great results. Thank you guys, you know who you are! Sadly, the server issues have rained on the parade. You can find an official statement and explanation from our producer Philipp here. Following the release, an increased amount of game crashes have also been reported, fixes for one of them is already included in today’s game update, please rest assured we continue working on that.

If the whole scent hound frenzy passed you by, be sure to check some videos so you know what all the fuss is about. Our community members ronMctube, Mills, Flinter have made some good ones, and also you can catch the recap of our official pre-release livestream with Pratze and Johanna.

We are also curious to hear what you think of your retrievers now that we’ve made some significant AI adjustments. Hopefully you’ll enjoy them more now. Anyway, test them and let us know.

The best classic rifle is chosen!

http://news.thehunter.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/06/SplashScreen_classicshowdown_winner.png

The hounds were the name of the game last week, so some of you might have missed the end of our much praised Classic Showdown event. It’s been a truly amazing event but the victory goes to the K98k Bolt-Action Rifle team, due to what was a trophy of a lifetime. A piebald elk scoring 421.261. Although my personal favourite rifle has won, I just want to say well done to everyone! Here are the results of all four team competitions, each of them is a great accomplishment in itself!
Team 8×57 IS K98kTeam 7.62x54RTeam .30-06Team .303
We’re inspired by the success of this event and will probably make something similar for other weapon classes, where applicable.

Football Jamboree 2016

http://news.thehunter.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/06/SplashScreen_jamboree2016_changabletext_2.png

And now onto an event of a totally different caliber. Those of you who have been with us long enough, must remember our Football Jamboree 2014 and the super-exclusive Royal Shotgun. Well, it’s time for another jamboree, this time with a slightly European flavour 😉 But don’t worry, we’ve also prepared something for those of you who are not that involved in the grand sporting event kicking off in France tomorrow. Why yes, there will be another exclusive “golden” weapon and this time it will be one of our most popular rifles in theHunter. Read on!

Lock&Learn

http://news.thehunter.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/06/splashscreen_lockandlearn_6.png

Lock&Learn is back as well, and this week Johanna will be joined by our Lead Client Programmer Danny and they will take it to our all-time favourite, Whitehart Island, and try to perform a shot through the hart 😉 Make sure you join if you’re available. If you’ve read some of Danny’s posts in the forum, you can probably guess that it’ll be worthwhile.

Robin is back!

http://news.thehunter.com/wp-content/uploads/2013/09/robin1.jpgIn one of our old status updates we told you the story of our programmer Robin who suffered a stroke about two years ago, and has been going through rehabilitation since then. A lot of you have been sending your best wishes to him, and Robin is so, so grateful for those! Today, after a long wait, we are finally delighted to tell you that Robin is back on the theHunter team. He is returning half-time initially and will slowly be working into full-time. He has already started working on a nice new feature and hopes that you will like it once it’s released. Once again, thank you to everyone who offered support and kind words.

That’s it from us for today, happy hunting!

notes.title: Status Update 27th May 2016
notes.notes:
Howdy hunters,

Let’s see what we’ve got for you today.

Testing of our precious scent hounds is in full gear and they’re starting to look more and more promising and inspiring each day. We hope to be able to release something truly amazing this time!
http://news.thehunter.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/CJ_WI_WT.jpg
Our client programmer Carl-Oscar and his loyal hound called Debugger with their first track and first kill

 

Scent Hounds – Pre-release Livestream

On Monday you’ll have an opportunity to see the new scent hounds in action, during our traditional pre-release livestream. This time our streaming resident and theHunter veteran Pratze will be joined by Johanna, who by the way has recently swooped into a full-time position at Expansive Worlds as Marketing Coordinator. Congratulations Johanna! Please join us on Monday 30th at 19:00 CEST on our official Twitch channel to enjoy some scent hound action.

As Johanna is busy preparing the livestream, there was no Lock&Learn today. Sorry to all the fans, hope to see you all on Monday!

Watch the announcement video

Sound Recording

As you will hear soon enough, our scent hounds have new sweet sounds. To record those, one February morning our sound designer Greg travelled all the way to a little Swedish village called Gränna to visit a lovely family of hunters who are also experienced dog trainers. Here’s a short photo report of Greg and the man of the house trying to trigger the typical bark of Gunnar, the Bluetick Coonhound, by hanging moose heads and fox skins off the trees. The family was super friendly and welcoming and helped Greg put Gunnar in good condition to get the best recordings possible for a great hunting experience. Thank you so much!

http://news.thehunter.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/Greg_1.jpg http://news.thehunter.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/Greg_2.jpg

http://news.thehunter.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/Greg_4.jpg

 

You will soon hear Gunnar and the results of Greg’s successful work in theHunter 😉

While in Gränna, Greg also tried to record some new Moose sounds, but the results were not as successful as the ones with Gunnar. Sadly, he didn’t manage to record anything worthy of adding to the game, but he still wanted to share with you a couple of pictures from the process:

http://news.thehunter.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/Greg_6.jpg http://news.thehunter.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/Greg_5.jpg

The Bow

http://static.thehunter.com/static/img/items/1024/compound_bow_pulsar.pngYesterday we released a new bow with a cosmic name, Pulsar. It’s our third compound bow, some say it’s somewhere in-between the Snakebite and the Parker Python, some say it eats them both for breakfast. We say give it a try and make up your own mind. Luckily there’s a nice little “bowndle” in the store with the bow, the 5-pin sight and a two person tree stand, on sale at a nice discount. And before you start testing out your new bow, be sure to activate the Compounds n’Treestands competition. You never know when the biggest turkey of your life might saunter by 😉

A Classic Showdown

http://news.thehunter.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/top_elk.jpg

One week of our Classic Showdown event has passed by and although we know that the top Roosevelt Elk by R1Maddin (on the picture) is pretty intimidating (it’s also a piebald, oh my) we’ve seen bigger ones in this game 😉 The main battle is still to be won and you have another week to bring your team to fame and glory. Go hunt some elk!

The current leading Roosevelt Elk for all the rifles:
Team .30-06 – 408.111 by KCROWETeam 7.62x54R – 417.679 by prohunter93Team .303 British – 389.134 by Marteau1245Team 8×57 IS K98k – 421.261 by R1Maddin
Free Species Rotation

For free species rotation we’re exchanging Arctic Fox and Roe Deer for Feral Hog and Bison. You can hunt them for free until next Thursday, June 2nd.

That’s it from us for today, see you all on Monday for the pre-release livestream!

Happy hunting!

notes.title: Status Update 20th may 2016
notes.notes:
Howdy hunters,

Welcome to our slightly belated weekly update.

New and (better) old stuff

On Wednesday we released a game patch with some new things, as well as improvements for old items. Nifty scopes for some of our old reliable rifles, enhanced functionality for the two person tree stand, new iron sights for the .243, .270 and .300 rifles, increased magnification for the spotting scope and more. You can find the full list here.

Battle of the classic rifles

We launched a pretty cool event which everyone seems to be really enjoying so far. A Classic Showdown. The whole community is divided into four teams and fighting against each other to have their chosen classic rifle named the best of the best. As you can tell, I am in team K98k (which is so going to win ;)). What about you? Have you picked your team yet?

http://news.thehunter.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/team_K98k.jpg

New collectibles

http://news.thehunter.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/SplashScreen_collectables_valdesbois.png

This week we also dropped a bunch of lovely eagle feathers and ammonite fossils on Val-des-Bois, one of the reserves that hasn’t had any collectibles until now. Later we will be adding some cool stuff for you to pick up on the other two empty reserves – Rougarou Bayou and Whiterime Ridge. Stay tuned!

Scent hound update

We are starting the testing phase for scent hounds, together with selected people who applied for our closed beta session. If you haven’t received an email from us this time, please don’t be discouraged. Hopefully next time you’ll be more lucky!

There have been a lot of questions about the upcoming scent hounds, everything shall be revealed in due course. We are also planning our traditional pre-release livestream where you can watch them with your own eyes.

With the release of scent hounds we’ll be tweaking the behaviour of our retrievers, so they will become a little bit smarter (but not as smart as their sniffing brothers and sisters). All the dog equipment and accessories, since it is manufactured from a top quality super stretch material, will of course fit both types of dogs.

We also wanted to share with you a couple of sneak peek screenshots of the scent hounds. They are work in progress, but still – what a beauty!

http://news.thehunter.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/scent_hound3.png http://news.thehunter.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/scent_hound2.png http://news.thehunter.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/scent_hound1.png

Service disruptions

Over Tuesday and Wednesday night we had some problems which were caused by service outages experienced by our server provider Google. Please read the statement by our producer Philipp here.

Free species rotation

http://news.thehunter.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/guest_hunting.pngFinally, the next two animals in our free species rotation are Arctic Fox and Roe Deer. You can hunt them for free until Thursday 26 May, when they will be exchanged again with two other species. Guest players are now able to see animals they are allowed to hunt in the top right corner of the website once logged in.

 

That’s it from us for today.

Happy hunting!

notes.title: Status Update 12th May 2016
notes.notes:
Howdy hunters,

Welcome to another weekly status update.

Multiplayer Issues

I’d like to start today with a couple of tidbits about what’s been happening in the game recently. For one, we had multiplayer connection issues at the end of last week and over the weekend. Sorry about those, they were fixed on Monday and you should now be able to join your friends’ games without any problems.

Server Disconnects

Over the last couple of days we’ve had some server hiccups that interfered with your games. Our backend team did some digging and identified the cause. We’ve been moving your old hunting data to a new database. As you might expect, it’s a significant amount of data and it created more load on the servers than we anticipated. Our apologies to those affected. We’ve now paused the data transfer and we’re looking into a more stable method of completing the task. Once we resume the process, game stability will not be affected.

Contacting Support

Several players have reported problems logging into our support page, as well as sending emails to our customer support address. This should be fixed now, if you’ve been unsuccessfully trying to get in touch with support and received no reply, please open another ticket at support.thehunter.com and we’ll help you out as soon as possible. If you are still experiencing this issue, email us at contact [at] expansiveworlds [dot] com.

New Spotting Scope

http://news.thehunter.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/SplashScreen_SpotttingScope_2016_05.pngYesterday we released a new spotting scope which generated a certain amount of mixed feedback. The general consensus appears to be that the gameplay advantage it offers doesn’t justify the price. Fair enough, that was a misjudgement on our part and we are happy to admit it. In an attempt to rectify this, we’re going to increase the magnification of the spotting scope from 12x to 16x. Thank you for your valued feedback as always!

The Exciting New Feature

Now let’s move on to the exciting stuff. It’s time for us to shed some light on our next feature! We dropped some sound hints in one the Lock&Learn recap videos as well as “forgot” to remove a paper from the whiteboard from Sacha’s intro picture. notes.title: Status Update - 27th April 2016
notes.notes:
Howdy hunters,

Here is our weekly status update, including what we’ve been up to at Expansive Worlds.

Sneakathon 2016

http://news.thehunter.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/SplashScreen_Sneakathon_2016_04.png

So, yesterday we launched a new hunting event which we’re planning to run every year – Sneakathon 2016. We combined a couple of tough challenges, featuring some of our most spooky species, into a set of missions for all non-competitive souls as well as a final Roe Deer competition. The feedback for the event has been very positive so far, which makes us happy campers. To help you out in the Sneakathon, we reduced the price on all Sneaky 3D clothes by 50%, which is even cheaper than our regular bundles. In the spirit of sneakiness, there’s also a brand new fall leaf camo variation of our favourite Ghillie suit, designed by Gostwind in our 2014 outfit competition!

Player Survey

Here’s a reminder that the player survey we launched last week is running until the end of this week. The number of entries so far has been overwhelmingly high, but we’re still missing a couple of thousand opinions. Your opinion counts, so please take the opportunity to share it with us. You only have one opportunity per year, and we’re looking forward to discovering the results.

Lock&Learn – Deer Diary

As you may remember, two weeks ago we started a regular live-streaming project, Lock & Learn. Our community intern Johanna is learning the ropes of theHunter and sharing her journey with everyone in weekly Twitch streams. Without question, theHunter is a challenging game with a rather steep learning curve, which can be overwhelming for new players, so with this project we wanted to show (in an entertaining way) how one takes their first steps in the game, learns from their mistakes and evolves into a bad-ass hunter. Johanna has already completed two streams, you can catch a recap of her first episode, The Moose Karma, here, and here is the recap of her second one, Deer Diary – watch it carefully and enjoy it thoroughly 😉 

Video

Unfortunately there will be no stream today, but next week Johanna will be joined by our veteran hunter ForstHeld, and a little birdie told me they will take to the fields of Hirschfelden where Forst will give Johanna some Red Fox hunting lessons. Anyway, hope to see you on next Thursday at 16:00 CEST on Expansive Worlds’ Twitch channel.

Next week’s free species

http://news.thehunter.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/free_species_week_2.png

We are continuing our experiment with free species rotation, and tomorrow Brown Bear and Moose will become premium again, while Alpine Ibex and Wild Boar will be free to hunt for the next 7 days. From next week onward the free species rotation will occur from Thursday to Thursday.

Team news

And now on to some team news. In the last few months, theHunter squad has undergone many changes. A bunch of people have left us and many more have joined. So, today we’re saying goodbye to our awesome animator Hampus, who has been with us for three years and has done some amazing work. The best of the best including the ibex fighting and labrador retriever animations. Good luck Hampus, you’ll be missed!

No goodbyes without hellos, and today we’re also welcoming a new member into the theHunter family. His name is Kristoffer and he’ll be working with us in the capacity of tools programmer, a completely new role for Expansive Worlds. Kristoffer’s work will be happening deep down behind the scenes, as he’ll be optimizing our engine tools to make the jobs of our programmers, artists and designers more efficient. Read Kristoffer’s intro below and say hello to him, although you won’t feel the direct impact of his work, what he does is extremely important and had a significant impact on the end result.

http://news.thehunter.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/Kristoffer-Bergman.jpgHello there!

My name is Kristoffer Bergman and I’ve just joined Expansive Worlds as a Junior Tools Programmer.

I come from a small village near Lund in Skåne and just recently moved to Stockholm. At the age of 16 I made my first “game”: a console based “Hangman” in Java that I made during summer vacation, and seeing my brothers play around with it and having fun just felt amazing. The “I made this, they like it, they are happy because of me” feeling was absolutely addicting, so naturally I was gonna spend the rest of my life at my computer, programming.

Fortunately for me, this didn’t come with a particularly big life change. Spending unhealthy amount of time by the computer has for a very long time been a big part of my life, and I have been playing video games ever since I got my first Gameboy Colour.

Until I found a job to have as an excuse for programming 24/7, my path was unclear. During my early school years, I was the go-to-guy before any math or natural science test to explain things, and I ended up really enjoying to help people understand how stuff works. I love programming just as much as helping people, so I dreamt of becoming a teacher as well as becoming a programmer.

Then I found The Game Assembly, which had a program in Game Programming. I didn’t even realise that “Game Programmer” was an actual job. When I got in, my dream of becoming a programmer was about to be fulfilled. The only downside was that this meant I wasn’t gonna become a teacher and help people. However, one day at one of our school projects, the content creators were annoyed because their tools weren’t working. I helped them solve it and ever since then I know that til the day I die, this is what I want to do.

We are finishing this status update with a short video about our parent company, Avalanche Studios, in which some members of the Expansive Words’ team have been spotted. I thought it would be interesting for you guys to see where we work and put some faces to names of those who work on the game, and who you (hopefully!) love http://news.thehunter.com/wp-includes/images/smilies/simple-smile.png Enjoy!

Video

Happy hunting!

notes.title: Status Update 22th April 2016
notes.notes:
Hello hunters,

Before you plunge into your weekend hunting, we wanted to catch a couple of minutes of your time to share some news.

http://news.thehunter.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/two_person_tree_stand.pngOn Tuesday we released a small patch with some fixes and a nifty new item. Two Person Tree Stand. Following its release, some people asked us to add the functionality to change sides in the tree stand, and boom, your wish is granted (well, it will be granted in one of the next game updates, right now Patrik is hard at work coding it ;))

Player survey – Tell us what you think!

As I announced last week, today we’re launching our annual player survey. We collect your feedback every day from what you share with us in the forums, support and social media channels, but once per year we launch a bigger questionnaire asking you all sorts of things about theHunter, the universe and everything. Such surveys help us reach as many of you as possible and collect a vast amount of community data, to make sure that we are developing the game you enjoy.

The theHunter 2016 survey will be open for 10 days, from today until May 2nd midnight CEST.   It will take you no longer than 15 minutes and we would appreciate your honest and detailed replies. Naturally, you can only participate once, but please ask your hunter friends to complete it as well. If you answer all the questions and fill in your theHunter name at the end, you’ll be automatically enrolled in our em$ draw, where we will randomly choose five players and gift them 1000 em$. You can also choose to submit your answers anonymously. Please note that even if you let us know your name, the information you provide will not be stored with your account details, shared, sold, distributed or used in any other way that may harm you.

Complete the survey

Introducing free species rotation

http://news.thehunter.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/SplashScreen_AnimalRotation_April11-15.png

Many of you probably remember that back in January we added an additional free species, Pheasant, and exchanged Mule Deer for Whitetail, which made it possible for guests to hunt five species for free. Today we’re adding another little tweak to the free species portfolio, a.k.a. Rotation of Free Species. As a part of this change we’ll rotate two of the five free species every week to bring more variety to guest hunts. The weekly rotation will occur on a Friday to Friday basis, and we’re starting today with exchanging Pheasant and Snowshoe Hare for Brown Bear and Moose. Free animals will be announced in status updates, via banner images, and social media. Please note that this in an experimental feature, nothing is set in stone yet, we are trying this out to see how it will be received and reserve the right to roll it back at any time. The information about the free species on our website and Steam store page will remain unchanged for now.

Hunting friends IRL

http://news.thehunter.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/wappen-waffen.pngThis sort of news always make me super happy. Last weekend there was another real life meetup of our awesome German community Jagdfreunde (Hunting Friends in English). We wrote about their first meet-up last year and it looks like the bonds are only getting stronger! 23 hunters travelled from different parts of Germany, some of them as far as 500 km to spend quality time together in the German community Willingen/Upland. The joint Hunter Score of all the participants was a whopping 37276, the average 1775.05 (wow) and the honourable hunters present were: babba01, barbarillo, CZ75Mamba, ForstHeld, Harry91220, KlausDieterMeyer, Lennox1983, Lobo78, Lou24, markus84, Meradim, michi1259, Onkel666, Pratze, Schwungi, schwungijunor, sepp201167, Silvano1, stoiba3, Tarismo, TonyRaptor.

Having great time in a picturesque place with like-minded people, sharing some wurst, drinks and theHunter stories, all spiced up with some fishing and bow shooting. Not much can beat it, wish I had been there too 😉

http://news.thehunter.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/jf_1.jpg

http://news.thehunter.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/jf_2.jpg

http://news.thehunter.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/jf_3.jpg

Here’s to the next year meet-up and Waidmannsheil!

Hunting Horn bonanza – Results

It’s time to announce the results of our Hunting Horn Bonanza video challenge! The amount of entries for this one hasn’t exactly been overwhelming, but we want nevertheless to thank the guys who put efforts into creating their videos and everyone who watched and commented on those. The team has been unambiguous when choosing the winner. Congratulations RegimentsTyp2! Your video is awesome, we showed it to the whole Avalanche Studios team during one of our meetings and everyone loved it.  Please contact me and let me know a prize of your choice (5000 em$ or a “Pathfinder” Membership Bundle).

You can watch the winning video here.

We also wanted to celebrate blendy who took the second place in this competition and offer a consolation prize of 1000 em$ or a 3 month membership. Get in touch with me to claim it, and thank you for your participation!

Welcome Mattias!
Finally, here is the introduction of our new 3D artist Mattias, say hello and welcome!

http://news.thehunter.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/mattias.jpg
Hello everybody, my name is Mattias Nordin.

I’m a 3D artist, previously worked on titles such as Little Big Planet and The Division.

I’ve just joined this awesome team of digital hunter-makers a week ago, and I’m looking forward to working here!

A little about myself, I’m originally from Hässleholm in Sweden where I was born and raised. I decided that I wanted to make games in 2007, so I got into the school called Sofe (School of future entertainment) in another small Swedish city, Karlshamn. While studying there I worked on Little Big Planet up until 2015. After a short stay in Malmö (at Massive game studio), I’ve now moved to Stockholm, where it all happens!

My hobbies and interests are mostly related to playing games. Right now I play a lot of BG:Siege of Dragonspear, Dota2, Cs:go and Factorio. I love to travel and spend time with my girlfriend. Everything from hiking to big city weekends and lazy beach holidays. I watch a lot of movies but not that many tv series, even though there’s always time for Rick and Morty!

I’m excited to be here and to (continue) make an awesome game.

Happy hunting!

Your video is awesome, we showed it to the whole Avalanche Studios team during one of our meetings and everyone loved it.  Please contact me and let me know a prize of your choice (5000 em$ or a “Pathfinder” Membership Bundle).

You can watch the winning video here.

We also wanted to celebrate blendy who took the second place in this competition and offer a consolation prize of 1000 em$ or a 3 month membership. Get in touch with me to claim it, and thank you for your participation!

Welcome Mattias!
Finally, here is the introduction of our new 3D artist Mattias, say hello and welcome!

http://news.thehunter.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/mattias.jpg
Hello everybody, my name is Mattias Nordin.

I’m a 3D artist, previously worked on titles such as Little Big Planet and The Division.

I’ve just joined this awesome team of digital hunter-makers a week ago, and I’m looking forward to working here!

A little about myself, I’m originally from Hässleholm in Sweden where I was born and raised. I decided that I wanted to make games in 2007, so I got into the school called Sofe (School of future entertainment) in another small Swedish city, Karlshamn. While studying there I worked on Little Big Planet up until 2015. After a short stay in Malmö (at Massive game studio), I’ve now moved to Stockholm, where it all happens!

My hobbies and interests are mostly related to playing games. Right now I play a lot of BG:Siege of Dragonspear, Dota2, Cs:go and Factorio. I love to travel and spend time with my girlfriend. Everything from hiking to big city weekends and lazy beach holidays. I watch a lot of movies but not that many tv series, even though there’s always time for Rick and Morty!

I’m excited to be here and to (continue) make an awesome game.

Happy hunting!

notes.title: Status Update 14th April 2016
notes.notes:
Hello hunters,

It’s Thursday and it’s the status update time.

Goodbye Tomas and welcome Mattias!

http://news.thehunter.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/tomas_lif.gifTo start with, we’ve got some team news for you. Our 3D artist Tomas, the creator of many an outfit, reserve, weapon, trophy and whatnot in theHunter, has left Expansive Worlds. It’s with a heavy heart we see him go but wish him only amazing things on his new roads and adventures. Say goodbye to him in the forum – he will appreciate it http://news.thehunter.com/wp-includes/images/smilies/simple-smile.png Tomas’ place in the team will be filled by Mattias. He is a fully fledged 3D artist with a bunch of gaming projects under his belt and we’re excited to see what he’ll bring to theHunter. Check our next status update to get to know Mattias!

Get better twice as fast!

The double XP weekend we promised a couple of weeks ago, after we’d fixed the issue with stats not being registered properly, is happening! From tomorrow, Friday 14:00 CEST lunchtime until Monday 14:00 CEST you will get double points for increasing your tracking, spotting and weapon skills. Good chance to catch up on your numbers, so don’t miss out!

Lock&Learn with Johanna
http://news.thehunter.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/SplashScreen_Streaming.png

Today we’re starting a new live-streaming project, “Lock & Learn”. Our wonderful community intern Johanna will be streaming from our official Twitch channel as she learns the ropes of theHunter, sharing her journey with you! She will be streaming every week on Thursday at 16:00 CEST from our official Twitch channel. Make sure to join, share your tips with her and of course ask some questions. We hope you can make it!

Hunter score update

Here is a heads-up from our backend developer Emil. If you’ve noticed that your Hunter score doesn’t get updated immediately after you’ve finished your hunt, don’t fret! Emil has deployed a small adjustment to make it easier for our servers, so achievements are now cached for one hour, so it will take some time for you to see your updated Hunter score.

Odds and ends

Next week we’ll be launching our large annual player survey, this will be your chance to share with us the good, the bad and the ugly 😉 Make sure to check our next status update for more details.

Here is a small reminder about our hunting horn competition. You still have a couple of days to make your video and win a nice prize!

http://news.thehunter.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/Lever_action_rifle_45_70_premium.pngAnd finally, you can now buy the premium .45-70 Lever Action Rifle Engraved. Grab that piece of art and set off to our most challenging reserve, Settler Creeks, to try your luck in this special big game challenge.

Happy hunting!

notes.title: Status Update 8th April 2016
notes.notes:
Howdy hunters!

Welcome to this week’s slightly belated status update.

First we’d like to shed some light on the recent server problems. As our producer Philipp announced in the forum on Monday, our servers fell victim to scripting attacks which led to significant service interruptions. Despite the safety measures our backend programmers implemented in an attempt to circumvent the attacks, our infrastructure continued to take a beating through Monday, Tuesday and Wednesday, forcing the servers to their knees. On Thursday Emil and Calle carried out a major change which we hope has put an end to the issue. There have been no subsequent outages or service interruptions. We will continue to monitor server performance to ensure stability so that you can continue to enjoy the game. On a side note, you can be absolutely sure that no personal data was accessed or compromised in any way.

In the hope of removing the bad aftertaste following the lost weekend, we added 3 extra days to existing memberships on Monday. Today we’ll be adding another 3 days as well as some sweet consumables – 100 bear and hog baits as well as a large bottle of scent eliminator to everyone. Just start the game before April 22nd and you will find these items in your inventory.

During the recent issues, you may have missed the release of a really nifty piece of equipment – the new Hunting Horn. It’s awesome, great fun to use, and we wanted to celebrate it with a little video competition. The only restriction is that your video must not exceed 2 minutes, contain no copyrighted material such as music or images, otherwise the sky is your limit. Make a little orchestra with your friends, stage a mini hunt, go nuts! You can find the thread with the rules here. The winner of this contest will receive a nice little prize of 5000 em$ or a Pathfinder membership bundle (winner can decide). Looking forward to your entries!

http://news.thehunter.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/2016_04_hornvideochallenge.png

And lastly, a note from our QA manager Dennis; there seems to have been a bit of confusion regarding the hog feeders lately, and a lot of people have been reporting unusual behaviour which they believe to be a bug. We’ve done some digging into this issue and we can confirm the hog feeders work as intended. This means that you need to pick up the right location for it to attract pigs. You can find the extensive info on how they work in our wiki.  What causes some confusion is that the feeders had been bugged before and for a long time, so they attracted pigs from all over the reserve. This has been fixed, together with the bear barrels bug fix back in 2015.

That’s it for today!

Happy hunting!

notes.title: Status Update - 31st March 2016
notes.notes:
Howdy hunters,

We are back from the Easter break and the exciting stuff I mentioned last week is starting to happen! Earlier today our backend programmer Emil performed server maintenance during which he deployed some important changes to how hunting statistics get saved in the database. Long story short, with these changes we are hoping to see the end of the tracking, spotting, travelling and skill data getting lost if the game doesn’t close properly. You can find the details of the server update here. Unfortunately, your already lost stats will not be registered retroactively, but we’re planning to run a double XP weekend soon, so you’ll have a chance to catch up! Stay tuned.

Just a couple minutes ago we also released a game patch with a bunch of cool things. Apart from some (did I say some? lots!)  fixes, we’re also listening to your feedback and trying to stick to our promise and invest more time and resources into improving the quality of the game. So, our sound designer Greg has given new voices to several weapons (he is super grateful for all the suggestions you shared with him in this thread). And our animation team has been revamping some old weapon animations to make them more alive and realistic. Here are some notes from our animation intern Morris, who has been mostly working on this, explaining the changes and the super cool video he made for you showing the evolution of the animations.

Revamped animations

Now that we have three animators on the project we feel that we have the time to begin reworking some of the older animations in the game. The way we’re approaching this is in layers, so for now we’re mainly focusing on the bigger animations per weapon; reloads and pumps. And when these are done and we have more time for more revamps we’ll continue with the next layer (could be idle variations, movement-animations, how the hands are holding the weapon, etc).

In the video we show an excerpt of how some of the animations are now (the old animations) followed by the new rework of those animations. Main things to notice is that with the new animations we’re focusing on a couple of things to improve:
Show the weapon from a better angle during reloads/pumps, i.e. if the character is inserting bullets we try to pose the weapon in a more natural way so that the player can see what is happening.Less robotic movements. Explains itself http://news.thehunter.com/wp-includes/images/smilies/simple-smile.pngHead and spine-movements during third person animations. Previously only the arms have been moving during the third-person animations, and it has been something we’ve wanted to fix.Different animations depending on whether the player is in standing or prone position. Only a minor thing, but some reloads will look a bit different in standing and prone for more immersion.


Free species weekend

http://news.thehunter.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/Free_hunt_weekend.png

To celebrate these hefty improvements and to thank you for your passion and loyalty, we’re making all animals free to hunt from today until the end of the weekend. Why yes, Polar Bear will be in a huntable mode and free as well. While this is mostly good news for guests, we wanted to do something for our members as well, so we put together a large equipment sale (starts around lunchtime CEST tomorrow) during which you can stock up on tents, tripods, blinds and similar stuff, because one can never have too many of those babies. There will also be a little weekend competition for you, check back for more news tomorrow.

Meet Johanna

Last but not least, we have another new face on the team. Meet our 2D/Community intern Johanna, she will be helping us with social media and, well, 2D graphics. She has already been studying the forums, learned some ropes from you guys and harvested her first Mulie! Say hello to Johanna 😉

http://news.thehunter.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/Johanna.jpgOhoy!
My name is Johanna Schramm and I am the new 2D/community intern here at Expansive Worlds, helping out on theHunter.
I am a game graphics student with a passion for social media and graphical design, currently finishing my bachelor’s degree at Södertörns Högskola. I have previously studied graphic design and communication as well as English. I am born and raised in Stockholm, where I also live today with my fiancé and our cat Strumpan (Swedish for sock). I spend most of my spare time on cosplay – making costumes from games/films/comics etc. (you can check my official Facebook page, if interested) and I also love art and eSports.
The first game I remember playing is Keen 4 on Windows 95. Ever since I have fallen in love with the magical world of games more and more. An interest that has led me all the way here!
As a child my family went camping for a few weeks every summer. We would sleep in a tent and hear the animals roaming around the forest, go fishing and cooking our food outside. I hope this has prepared me for this great hunter adventure!
I hope to create content that you can all enjoy. I’m truly astonished by the passion theHunter brings out in the community, and I’m super excited to be a part of it!

That’s it for today, happy hunting all!

PS: There have been some questions about our traditional April Fool’s pranks. To the utter disappointment of our stand-up prankster game designer April Primera, responsible for all our previous gems (such as this, this and of course this), this year we’ve decided to follow the feedback we’ve read in the forums and not do anything foolish and instead focus on more serious things, such as bugs.
