notes.title: Status Update 29th January 2015
notes.notes:
Hi there and welcome to our weekly status update hunters!

We’re starting with a cool piece of news…

Something non-typical has been spotted in Rougarou Bayou

Last week we mentioned that Peter had been working on a long-time community request and now we are ready to tell you what it is – the creme de la creme of antlers. Non-typical antlers! They are already made and released for Whitetail Deer, and if we see an interest, more might follow. Here’s a tidbit from Peter who has mostly been behind this beauty:

Non-Typical Antlers

This is a feature that has been on the wishlist for a looong time now! Perhaps it’s something that will also be more appreciated by our long-time players and more experienced irl hunters. The antler system is one of the most complicated features in theHunter, and also one that pretty much every player has strong opinions about. And perhaps rightly so, as the antlers is a part of the very heart of the game. In order to improve the production value (how much time and money something costs to implement), we’ve made an effort to slightly simplify the system that we use for handling non-typical antlers and have come up with a solution that made all this possible. Future additions to the range of non-typical antlers should not be as complicated and time consuming to add and modify as the typical antlers. Non-typical antlers in theHunter will not be as common as the typical ones (as they are not in reality). But they will not be nearly as rare as some of our albino and melanistic animal variations. All players should have a chance to enjoy an occasional non-typical trophy!

To begin with, we have added non-typical antlers to the Whitetail Deer, and if things go as planned and this feature turns out to be appreciated we definitely intend to add more of them for other species like the Mule Deer and Blacktail, and quite possibly to any other animal for whom it makes sense. Like in real life hunting, the non-typical antlers will feature separate leaderboards, to avoid making a mess of your record trophies, and they utilize realistic scoring (Boone & Crockett), like the rest of them.

Go find some non-typical Whitetails and share your trophy shots and screenshots in this thread.

Apart from non-typical antlers, today we released a pack of 10 new missions featuring the latest addition to EHR – European Rabbit. Have fun with those!

Say hello to Pranav

Today we’re also introducing a new member of our team – Pranav, who has recently joined our client programmer squad.

Hi everyone!

I’m Pranav Tekchand and am excited to be part of the Expansive Worlds team. I’m a developer from India and have been working in the games industry there since I graduated eight years ago. I got into simple programming as a preteen when I scored an obsolete computer (a TRS-80 at a time when 286 PCs were new) at a repair shop that didn’t know what to do with it. On my next “non-obsolete” (386) machine I played a lot of games and soon got to a point where I started wondering how interesting it would be to make them. Getting internet access and seeing the first 3D games really got me focused as I got access to resources about programming games and graphics. I enjoy solving puzzles, coming up with solutions and relish the enjoyment people feel by games or tools I’ve helped with.

Before moving to Sweden, I lived in the beach town of Goa and used to swim many laps in my free time. I enjoy the outdoors and sports, and was on New Delhi’s state basketball team while in high school. These days I go rock climbing with many of my friends at Expansive Worlds and Avalanche Studios.

I look forward to have a part in many moments that’ll fill you with joy while playing our games!

Happy hunting!

notes.title: Status Update 22nd January 2015
notes.notes:
Howdy hunters,

It’s Thursday here and it’s time for another status update from the EW team.

The main news today is the release of the 21st animal of the EHR and the 6th resident of Val-des-Bois –

Mr. European Rabbit!

As we mentioned in the last status update, it’s a variation of our existing species, Cottontail Rabbit, and it’s free to hunt for all guests as well. Apart from new looks, it also got unique gameplay. Here is some information from our game designer Björn which should help you when hunting this coy cute little critter.

Burrow Gameplay

The European Rabbit shares many traits with its North American cousin but there is one major difference – Burrows. When a Cottontail spooks it tries to find thick vegetation to hide in but the European Rabbit has taken it a step further by digging elaborate burrow systems to which it can retreat when threatened.

In theHunter European Rabbits live in colonies tied to burrow systems, randomly generated throughout the fields of Val-des-Bois. It’s rare that a group of rabbits strays farther than 100 meters away from their burrows, which makes them easier to locate than other animals. The problem is though, that when spooked they retreat into a nearby hole and thus become unreachable by would-be hunters. But fear not, our rabbits have a notoriously short memory and they’ll eventually surface from a randomly selected hole in the burrow system. Patience and massive amounts of airborne pellets are the king when hunting… The Wabbit!

By tradition, with the release of the European Rabbit we also throw in a new weapon – the slick and beautiful 20 GA Semi-Automatic Shotgun “Carbon” and a special competition in which you’ll get to shoot them bunnies. Regular missions and competitions for the European Rabbit are already in the works too.

Apart from the European Rabbit, the backend and client programming teams have been working on bug fixes (check out the full list of them in today’s game update). The new reserve is slowly taking its shape and awesomeness in the crafty hands of our artists Tomas, Sandra, Oscar and the game designer Daniel. Peter has started working on another long time community request which we’ll hopefully be able to tell you more about soonish.

And last but not least, today and tomorrow we’re running a special campaign – you can get a Deployable Hunting Tower when buying a 3-month membership or a Wayfarer bundle.

That’s it from us for today, now go let yourself loose on those wabbits!

Happy hunting!

notes.title: Status Update 14th January 2015
notes.notes:
Hey hunters,

Welcome to yet another week with the most realistic hunting game ever created. The EW team has come up to speed and work in the office is once again humming. Here are some nuggets of information on what we’ve been busy with:


 The programmers and backend guys have been digging into client and web-related bugs, glitches, issues and similar annoying stuff. On Tuesday we released a game update with a bunch of fixes, but the digging continues and we are hoping to be able to bake some more patches for you in the next month.

 We thought it’s about time to tell you about the next big thing we’ll be working on. The art team has taken a first stab at our new reserve! As usual, we won’t be revealing the location or giving any hints until the time is right. As you must know, a reserve takes months of work from the whole crew. Similarly, we can’t announce the release date yet, it will be ready when it’s ready.

 There is something else you can also start looking forward to. Another new animal! To be fair, it won’t be a completely new creature but a variation of an existing species we have in theHunter, but it will add a fresh touch to Val-des-Bois, where it will reside. The new animal is currently being tested and tweaked and we’re hoping to release it to the EHR quite soon(ish). Now, what might it be? ;) Share your thoughts and guesses in the comments.

 The last Ask Me Anything with our client programmers Andres and Danny took a while to close, sorry we kept you waiting for replies. The guys have been really busy these last months, plus they received a record number of questions - 91! Well, it’s better later than never, so here are their replies: on the engine, rain and all the discreet charm and challenges of being a client programmer. Check them out - cool stuff!


That's it from us for today.

Happy hunting!

notes.title: Status Update 8th January 2015
notes.notes:
Howdy Hunters,

We are back from our winter break and are now catching up on everything and anything that happened with and about theHunter during our absence. Here is a round-up for you:


Many players have been reporting multiplayer issues when people were not able to join MP games. We implemented a fix yesterday and will continue monitoring this. If you’ve been experiencing the problem, please make sure to let us know, either in the forums or on our social media channels, whether the issue has been resolved for you.

On December 19th, right after the team signed off for the vacations, a major bug occurred, which broke the functionality of scope reticles and HUD GUI elements (blinds, tents etc.) Our programmers fixed the issue on the next day, but the game was pretty much unplayable for about 24 hours. To reimburse you for this interruption, we’ll add 1 extra day to all memberships. We’re bummed about this unfortunate incident and especially its bad timing and we’ll try to prevent this from happening in the future.

As per the special Primal deal, all the shotguns and extra memberships have now been added. If you still haven’t received your membership and have fulfilled all requirements, please contact our support and they’ll sort it out for you.

We recently have become aware of a malicious phishing web-site: “playthehunter [dot] net”, which looked exactly like our official thehunter.com‘s first page. (Huge thanks to our community members who alerted us!) We’ve investigated this and it looks like the purpose was to lure our players into entering their theHunter usernames and passwords in order to steal/abuse them, so called phishing. There was also a link to a file hosted on a Google drive account, which most likely was ridden with malware and viruses.We’ve contacted both the hosting provider of the site and the domain registering company (the domain was registered with false information), and the site has now been taken offline.

If you visited this site, or fear that you may have without realizing it, we suggest that you run a virus scan on your computer and update your account information with a new password.

If you’ve become a victim of the culprits behind the website, please contact our support from the email address you used when registering at theHunter and we’ll help you to get your account back.

Please note that only thehunter.com and Steampowered.com are official publishing platforms of theHunter. It is of course very important for us to protect our players and our own brand from evil doers, but we do not have control over and, thus, can not help about anything happening outside our official publishing platforms, even if it’s somehow related to theHunter.

And last but not least… Meet Sandra – our latest addition to the art team who joined us yesterday. Read her intro below and say hi in the forums.

Hello!

My name is Sandra and I’m super happy to be joining the team at Expansive Worlds where I’ll be working as an environment artist. Previously I’ve worked at Guerrilla Games in Amsterdam but being back in my hometown Stockholm is a real treat!

I have a background in fine arts and graphical design but a few years ago I started to dabble in 3D and of course I got hooked. It’s just so much fun! I did my studies at Futuregames here in Stockholm from where I graduated in September last year.

When I’m not working I like to cook, and especially eat, food. Playing games, watching a movie or just having a cold one with my friends are also things you might find me doing on my spare time.

Happy hunting!

notes.title: Status Update 18th December 2014
notes.notes:
Hello hunters,

Welcome to the last status update in 2014! Tomorrow our team is leaving for Christmas vacations to spend quality time with their families which means there will be no updates or newsletters for the next two and a half weeks. We’ll be back at the office on January 7th, ready to start another chapter in the theHunter history. Please note that our support hours will also be reduced during the holiday season.Thank you for your understanding!

Peter on the art in theHunter

Our art director Peter Johansson has recently made a long in-depth interview for a 3D art magazine 3D Art Direct. In it he is sharing how an artist designs 43 square miles of real-time 3D wilderness (to us known as EHR), and make it convincing enough for experienced real-life hunters to enjoy. If you want to get fundamental behind-the-scenes information on theHunter art, this is definitely a must for you to check out. You can read the interview by registering on the magazine’s website. You’ll receive an online version in your email inbox.

Looking back at 2014


It’s been a truly amazing, mind-blowing, flabbergasting year for all of us at theHunter and we want to thank you, our community, for spending it with us, playing the game, sharing your thoughts and stories in the forums and guiding us in the development. We hope that you’ll stay with us in the next year as well, we’ve already planned a bunch of stuff and we can’t wait to hear what you think of it.

We’ve looked back at 2014, at everything that has happened in theHunter and crunched some numbers to make an end-of-the-year wrap-up.

Here is what has been achieved in 2014:

    New reserve – 1
    New species – 4
    New weapons – 15
    New pieces of equipment – 26
    New items of clothing – 39
    New special event items – 38
    New game features – 3
    New missions – 130
    New competitions – 114
    Bugs fixed – 150+
    Special events – 13
    Tutorials – 1
    Community created competitions and prize draws – 46
    New people joined the EW team – 10
    New people joined the community forums – 3 405
    Supports tickets answered – 18 136
    Release on Steam nailed – 1
    Player surveys created and replied to – 2
    Questions answered by Devs in Ask Me Anything – 264
    Store Discounts / Sales – 57
    Free species hunts – 8


I’ve also asked the team and community members to share their personal highlights of 2014, and here are some of them. For more of team and community highlights of 2014 check your inbox for the theHunter newsletter, holiday edition.

Daniel Jansson, EW Game Designer: My favorite was the Summer Fiesta because it was really fun to make difficult missions and then seeing people on the forum helping each other out by posting tips and strategies.

JackRbbt, community member and Romanian translator: The new additions: Val-de-Bois, Alpine Ibex and, of course, new rifle for it: Stambecco. Also, but this is something quite personal, Romanian localization.

Andrés Hansson, EW Lead Client Programmer: The highlight of 2014 was when we released theHunter on Steam and got a lot of new players.

TundraPuppy, Community member and Forum moderator: My favorite theHunter related thing was the release of the air rifle and rabbits in May. It was an excellent belated birthday present because it represented an interesting change for theHunter – not only did we see a move towards smaller prey (as opposed to deer) which also required more careful and precise aiming (as opposed to the more twitchy sky-filled-with-lead shooting of birds), but we also got a new weapon which isn’t a traditional gunpowder based weapon – it has excellent range, is very precise, and was tailor made for small prey which means we could see more small prey added with an existing valid weapon to use on them. It was an interesting shift for the game which helped add variety and options for people who were tired of the same-old same-old hunting options we previously had.

Jose Diaz, EW Animator: Interaction animations between the Ibex made by Hampus. More of that!

Blind Mole, Communtiy member: Official: new map Val-de-Bois
Non-official: caledonianblues’s competition “Gotta hunt them all”

Pratze, Community member and Video creator: Highlights of 2014 - Video

That’s it from us for today and this year, happy holidays and see you in 2015!

Please note that our support hours will also be reduced during the holiday season.Thank you for your understanding!

Peter on the art in theHunter

Our art director Peter Johansson has recently made a long in-depth interview for a 3D art magazine 3D Art Direct. In it he is sharing how an artist designs 43 square miles of real-time 3D wilderness (to us known as EHR), and make it convincing enough for experienced real-life hunters to enjoy. If you want to get fundamental behind-the-scenes information on theHunter art, this is definitely a must for you to check out. You can read the interview by registering on the magazine’s website. You’ll receive an online version in your email inbox.

Looking back at 2014


It’s been a truly amazing, mind-blowing, flabbergasting year for all of us at theHunter and we want to thank you, our community, for spending it with us, playing the game, sharing your thoughts and stories in the forums and guiding us in the development. We hope that you’ll stay with us in the next year as well, we’ve already planned a bunch of stuff and we can’t wait to hear what you think of it.

We’ve looked back at 2014, at everything that has happened in theHunter and crunched some numbers to make an end-of-the-year wrap-up.

Here is what has been achieved in 2014:

    New reserve – 1
    New species – 4
    New weapons – 15
    New pieces of equipment – 26
    New items of clothing – 39
    New special event items – 38
    New game features – 3
    New missions – 130
    New competitions – 114
    Bugs fixed – 150+
    Special events – 13
    Tutorials – 1
    Community created competitions and prize draws – 46
    New people joined the EW team – 10
    New people joined the community forums – 3 405
    Supports tickets answered – 18 136
    Release on Steam nailed – 1
    Player surveys created and replied to – 2
    Questions answered by Devs in Ask Me Anything – 264
    Store Discounts / Sales – 57
    Free species hunts – 8


I’ve also asked the team and community members to share their personal highlights of 2014, and here are some of them. For more of team and community highlights of 2014 check your inbox for the theHunter newsletter, holiday edition.

Daniel Jansson, EW Game Designer: My favorite was the Summer Fiesta because it was really fun to make difficult missions and then seeing people on the forum helping each other out by posting tips and strategies.

JackRbbt, community member and Romanian translator: The new additions: Val-de-Bois, Alpine Ibex and, of course, new rifle for it: Stambecco. Also, but this is something quite personal, Romanian localization.

Andrés Hansson, EW Lead Client Programmer: The highlight of 2014 was when we released theHunter on Steam and got a lot of new players.

TundraPuppy, Community member and Forum moderator: My favorite theHunter related thing was the release of the air rifle and rabbits in May. It was an excellent belated birthday present because it represented an interesting change for theHunter – not only did we see a move towards smaller prey (as opposed to deer) which also required more careful and precise aiming (as opposed to the more twitchy sky-filled-with-lead shooting of birds), but we also got a new weapon which isn’t a traditional gunpowder based weapon – it has excellent range, is very precise, and was tailor made for small prey which means we could see more small prey added with an existing valid weapon to use on them. It was an interesting shift for the game which helped add variety and options for people who were tired of the same-old same-old hunting options we previously had.

Jose Diaz, EW Animator: Interaction animations between the Ibex made by Hampus. More of that!

Blind Mole, Communtiy member: Official: new map Val-de-Bois
Non-official: caledonianblues’s competition “Gotta hunt them all”

Pratze, Community member and Video creator: Highlights of 2014 - Video

That’s it from us for today and this year, happy holidays and see you in 2015!

notes.title: Status Update 11th December 2014
notes.notes:
Hello hunters,

It’s time for a status update from us and here is what’s been cooking up here, in one of the darkest corners of the world right now:

Holiday Event update

It looks like many of you have been enjoying the Holiday Event, but there has been a fair amount of negative feedback received, mostly due to the bugs and other issues affecting the event page, scoring etc. We tried to jump on and fix these as soon as they were reported and we hope these issues have not put people off the whole event. Thank you for staying with us throughout the event and lots of other hiccups that have happened during this year! Here’s a small holiday gift from us –  the warm and cozy knitted sweater for long hikes in Hemmeldal. You can get it for free from the store during the next 2 days, hurry up and claim your present.


Movember donation

November is over, and so is our Movember campaign. Our community bought 1624 moustaches which equals $3248 worth of donations. The corresponding amount in Swedish crowns has been transferred to the Movember foundation and will go towards the research of men’s cancer and health issues. Thank you for your contribution everyone, you were great!

Hooray to our volunteer teams

Once again, we wanted to thank our amazing volunteer moderators, translators and wiki team, over 70 people all together, for the tremendous job they’re doing for the theHunter community, making the game accessible and enjoyable all over the world, keeping the forums a clean and welcoming community where everyone’s opinion is heard and respected, and collecting and storing the bulks of the fine theHunter knowledge for you to become a better player. As a small token of our appreciation, we’ve created special T-Shirts, so you can recognize them while hunting.

If you have passion for theHunter (and some spare time) and want to help the community in any way, you’re welcome to apply to join any of our volunteer teams!

What’s going on with Primal

As we’re approaching the release date of the theHunter’s small but scary brother (we’ve said before Christmas, right?), people are starting to get impatient. So, here is some news for you hunters: it’s been decided that Primal will first be released on December 15th, as an Early Access game on Steam. During the Early Access phase we’ll be collecting feedback from the community and working on additional features and tweaks before the proper, full release, next year. You can read more about our plans regarding Primal on its Store page – and while you’re on there, be sure to add it to your wish list as well ;)

Happy hunting!

notes.title: Status Update 28th November 2014
notes.notes:
Hello hunters,

Here comes our weekly status update.

theHunter’s little brother revealed

Most of you have probably read our Monday announcement in which we introduced the new project of Expansive Worlds, called theHunter: Primal. The announcement has attracted a lot of attention across the globe, which makes us happy and humbled. We won’t reiterate on this further in this update, if you missed the post on Monday, make sure to read it. For more news on this project, please follow Primal on Facebook and Twitter.

Smells like reindeer…

December with all its festivities and special vibes is crawling closer and closer. Last year’s Holiday countdown event was a huge success, so we decided to keep the same format this year, with a bit of adjustments and unexpected treats (of course ;)). The main theme of this year’s event is going to be (surprise, surprise!) a reindeer, and we are kicking it off on Monday, December 1st, and will keep you busy every single day up until the Christmas day, December 25th. Expect more details on this on Monday.

Until then you still have a couple of days to join our Thanksgiving fest and shoot yourself some sneaky Turkey, fortunately, it’s free to hunt until the end of the week.

Here’s to Robin!

On a final note, we wanted to share with you something more serious and personal. Back in August a very sad incident occurred involving our client programmer Robin (you might remember him by his racoon avatar on the forum and his cheerful posts). In late August he suffered a stroke which came as a huge shock to all of us since Robin was only 23 and very fit and healthy at the time. The months since then have been extremely tough for him and his girlfriend, his family and the whole EW team. Robin is an amazing individual who is very much loved by everyone around him. Today, we are happy to tell you that  the worst is over, Robin has been making great success in what we expect to be a full recovery! He has been a true trooper and we’re incredibly proud of him. We visited Robin yesterday and he asked us to send his regards to the community. Robin can’t wait to get back to working on theHunter.

That’s it from us for today.

Happy hunting!

notes.title: Status Update 21st November 2014
notes.notes:
Howdy hunters,

Here is a short status update from us.

The beginning of a new era

Today starts the new, 17th, season in theHunter, yay! The 16th season has been a long and luscious one, with 4 new species and one reserve added. We’ll be celebrating the beginning of a new era with a free species hunt. Two of the four animals released during the 16th season, Canada Goose and Alpine Ibex, will be free to hunt from the official start of the 17th season and throughout the whole weekend. We’re also running a weekend sale on all goose-related items in the store, including extra discounts on goose decoy bundles and the popular Canada Goose Starter bundle. It’s a good day for those of you who have been dreaming to set up a second (or a third) goose spread on Hirschfelden.


Turkey fest is coming

On Monday we’re kicking off yet another holiday event – Thanksgiving in theHunter. There will be lots of turkey challenges in all forms with varying difficulty levels. Stay tuned for more!

TheHunter quiz – results

We received 1110 responses to the quiz announced in the last status update, out of which 788 people answered all 30 questions and 74 got all of them correctly. With this project we mostly wanted to get hunters to use the wiki more actively by showing how much valuable information about the game one can find there. On the other hand, I hope that the quiz was enjoyable and useful also for those of you who wanted to test their ”raw” knowledge of the game, without digging into any extra sources.

Here are the names of the 5 winners of the em$ draw, randomly chosen out of 74 people who answered all questions correctly.

    StriderBurp
    kestuxx
    foresterjoe
    Krystal
    Cogsy666

The detailed results of the quiz can be found in this forum thread.

Break Action vs. Bullpup

And last but not least, on Wednesday we released a shiny new 7mm Break Action Rifle. The earlier released Bullpup of the same caliber divided the community into two camps, with a lot of people asking for a 7mm rifle with a more traditional hunting design, so we decided to do something about it, plus such a rifle has been a long time community request. So here it is. And in order to solve the community dispute, we’ve thrown in a small challenge – two identical competitions, one featuring the Bullpup, the other the Break action. Let’s see which one wins ;)

That’s it for today, more news next week!

Happy hunting!

notes.title: Status Update 13th September 2014
notes.notes:
Hey you hunters,

It’s status update time and here’s what’s been cooking up here in our corner of the world:

Events, events, more events

The Nordic Father’s Day last weekend turned out to be a ball and a hell lot of reindeer got shot. Although there’s been a fair deal of frustration here and there, mostly attributed to the elusive trio of 450’s, overall, the event was a success, with as many as 1266 hunters having completed the first mission, 402 the second, and 504 the third.

Now, the ongoing Mid-November Madness is a different kind of hoopla. We know that a lot of you have love-hate relationships with the 100% harvest value requirement, but we thought it’d be rewarding to add in an extra challenge, calling for some additional thinking over the choice of weapons. Fame and glory as well as a unique trophy set will be a reward for top 10 hunters in each of the 9 divisions – well worth a hassle.

There’ll be more events in the weeks to come, don’t get lost in the wild and be sure to follow our news and updates.

How well do you know theHunter?

During some 6 years of theHunter’s existence (in fact, the first forum member registered almost exactly 6 years ago), the game has spawned a truly colossal wealth of knowledge, stories and personal anecdotes.

So, here is a small quiz for you to check just how well you know the game and all its nooks and crannies. No worries, no theHunter myths and anecdotes this time, only hard facts and publicly accessible knowledge. The quiz was prepared by our awesome Wiki team who are doing an excellent job collecting and storing all theHunter know-how for the generations of hunters to come. Thank you guys, your work is invaluable!

The quiz consists of 30 multiple-choice questions (only one correct answer per quesion). If you answer 100% of the questions correctly, you’ll be automatically entered into our final em$ draw, during which we’ll randomly pick 5 people and award them each with 1000em$ (don’t forget to enter your theHunter name at the end of the quiz form if you want to be a part of the draw). You can submit your answers up until Sunday, November 16th, midnight CET, the correct answers and lucky draw winners will be announced on Monday.

Take the quiz

Interview with Björn

Our game designer Björn has recently been interviewed by the website GameStakers. He has shared some behind-the-scenes information about the development process and tips on how to succeed in the game. You can read the whole piece here.

New interns in town

This week we’ve welcomed two new interns to the theHunter squad: Pär joined our game design team and Carl-Oscar the programming team. Read their intros below and give them a good welcome in the forum.

Pär

Hello Guys and Gals,

My name is Pär and this Monday I started my game design internship here, at Expansive Worlds.

The first game I’ve ever played was probably Alley Cat, an old DOS game. My interest for games grew quickly and I started playing pretty much any game that my parents allowed me to. My favourite genre is and has been RPG ever since I played that first Diablo game. It did not take long until I dreamed of making my own games.

Gaming is still a pretty big part of my life, whenever I find the time for it. My free time I mostly spend on either side projects or with my girlfriend whom I have been together with for 9 years.

It took quite a while before I actually started following my dream and began to work my way up to become a game developer. When I was about 21 my girlfriend found a game development educational programme in Stockholm, which I did not even know existed at that time. I am originally from the northern part of Sweden but as I got into that programme, I relocated to the Stockholm area. Now I have been through 2 different educational programmes which finally led me to Expansive Worlds where I hope and believe I will fit right in.

Carl-Oscar

Hello out there!

My name is Carl-Oscar Lönn and I’ve just joined Expansive Worlds as an intern. I will be a part of the Client Programming team to bring you new content.

I am originally from the Swedish city called Trollhättan, this is where my beloved family lives. There I studied game development and found my calling, programming. After I was done with studies I went to Falun to further develop my skills at Playground Squad.

When I am not working, I like being at home, playing games and having a cup of tea. I also like to get out and do some geocaching. Sometimes I don’t feel like doing it on my own, but my father often keeps me company.

It feels great to get this opportunity to be a part of the team, so I will give it all and I hope you’ll have a good time hunting.

Happy hunting from the rest of the EW team!

notes.title: Status Update 9th October 2014
notes.notes:
Hello hunters,

It’s status update time and today we're happy to tell you that the Expansive Worlds' crew has grown, again! Three new team members have joined us to work on a side project, not related to theHunter. What's it about, you'll all find out when the time is right, as for now – please meet our new artist Simone, animator Dick and client programmer Anders. You can get to know them in the intros in our blog and say ”Hi” in the forums.

The new .22 ”Grasshopper” Pistol

Today we released a new weapon that has been suggested and requested by the community for a long, long time – the .22 ”Grasshopper” pistol, specially designed for hunting birds and small game. Following the introduction of the ”Grasshopper”, the ethical animals list for .357 revolvers will be adjusted. From now on it won't be permitted for mallards, geese or pheasants, since, as many of you have pointed out in the past, it's too large a caliber for birds. The reason why birds were on the ethical list before is that we simply didn't have a handgun option for them, which has changed now. Enjoy “grasshopping”!

Val-des-Bois will be less full now

Many players have touched on the fact that the new reserve seems to be more densely populated than the rest of the EHR. Following this discussion, we've made some re-evaluation and slightly lowered the numbers of Roe Deer, Red Deer and Red Fox on Val-des-Bois due to overcrowding in the lower part of the reserve. The narrow shape of the valley pushed animals together too much which indeed resulted in a less realistic animal population, compared to other reserves.

TheHunter went viral

Recently theHunter has been enjoying a lot of attention on Twitch and YouTube, which is really cool! In the last week a bunch of popular gaming channels have made videos of theHunter with total combined views of almost 3 million. You can check some of the videos on these channels: SergeantMerrel, TheDevildogGamer, jacksepticeye, SeaNanners Gaming Channel, CriousGamers, TheRPGMinx.Thanks for spreading the word about theHunter everyone, we love what you do!

That's it for today, happy hunting!

notes.title: Status Update 2nd October 2014
notes.notes:
Howdy hunters,

It’s been a week since Val-des-Bois was released and from the feedback we’ve gathered so far you seem to love it, and so do do we! There have been lots of nice videos and live streams shared in the forums and social media, thank you everyone for doing a great job showing the beauty of Val-des-Bois. Here are a couple of our favourite community videos:

By Aryvuel

By yakuza8183

 
Ask me Anything with Andrés and Danny

It’s been a while since our last AMA session with NAOutdoors, so now, when we’ve come down from our Val-des-Bois release madness, we thought it’s time to to do it again, since you’ve probably built up lots of new questions for us. This time it will be a double AMA with our client programmers Andrés and Danny – don’t miss your chance to pick their brains with tough questions about the physics, performance and logic of the game, as well as other trickeries. Andrés is also one of our team veterans and has been working on theHunter the longest, he allegedly has heaps of secret game knowledge, so make sure to ask the right questions ;) Please note that, although Andrés and Danny are our ”bug fixers”, they will not be able to reply or comment on specific bug reports and questions like: ”Why isn’t X bug fixed yet?”, please use our bug forums for such queries.

Andrés and Danny’s AMA thread will be unlocked for 48 hours, starting at 9:30 CEST on October 3rd. All the questions will be moderated and supervised by the moderation team, the standard AMA rules apply.


All theHunter goodness in your inbox


This week we’re launching our own newsletter. It will be sent out weekly and will be packed with news and updates, special campaigns and promotions, interesting tidbits from our community and other goodies. If you want to keep up to speed with everything going on about theHunter but don’t have time or energy to regularly check our news feed, forum and social media, this is definitely something for you. To receive our newsletter, enter your email in this form and hit ”Subscribe”. You can unsubscribe any time and we promise not to send you any junk, only great stuff!

Happy hunting!

notes.title: Status Update 25th September
notes.notes:
Hey all good hunters,

Val-des-Bois is released!

Amazing news – our new reserve Val-des-Bois is finally released! It is the 8th of the Evergreen Hunting Reserves with the total combined area of approximately 75 km2 - pretty mind blowing, huh? The new reserve comes with a whole bunch of breathtaking views and unconquerable peaks for you to master. We know that there are a lot of questions and speculations going on about how exactly climbing works, so Björn put together some notes for you explaining all the ins and outs of the new feature, make sure to read them before challenging those ridges. During the preparation for the pre-release live stream, our community member HooCairs has also made a short video showing how climbing and fall damage works.

Free roe hunt until the end of the week

We want all our players, both members and guests, to get the feel and thrill of hunting in the new reserve, so we're kicking off the release of Val-des-Bois with a free roe deer hunt which will last up till Sunday midnight. No memberships or licenses will be required and .243 Bolt Action Rifle is permitted for roes.

Alpine Ibex hunting tips

The biggest hit of Val-des-Bois is of course the new species, the Alpine ibex. Hunting Alpine Ibex will perhaps be the most difficult hunting in theHunter so far. They are wary and quiet animals who blend in well in their native Alpine environment. The Alpine Ibex do not call like other species in the game, for this reason there are no callers available, which makes it one of the species that require pure “spot and stalk” style of hunting. It is possible to get audio clues from the Ibex but these are sparse (and are never calls). To make things even more complicated, the Alpine Ibex are skilful climbers. They can climb almost vertical cliff faces with ease, so going after them will require a great deal of knowledge of the area: some steep surfaces may be possible for you to climb, others will lead to a quick drop down to harm. Wise hunters always bring a first aid kit along when hunting Ibex in Val-des-Bois. It will be tempting to fire at an Alpine Ibex high up on a mountain wall but it may have unfortunate consequences: there is a risk that the animal will get stuck where you can not reach it to harvest. When hunting Alpine Ibex, there should be a lot of planning going into every shot to avoid losing that great trophy. After all, that is what makes hunting Alpine Ibex worth it: those magnificent horns!

Re-watch the live streams

Many of you have already seen some bits of Val-des-Bois and Ibex hunting during our pre-release livestreams on Monday. Despite some technical problems on our side which caused the delay of the English live stream and for which we apologize, it became a fantastic community event. As many as 3 000 unique viewers, with 650 people simultaneously at the peak time, watched the English live stream! Huge thanks to everyone who helped to organize this event, participated in the chat with their questions and simply watched. For those you who missed it or just want to re-watch it at your own pace, here are the links to the replays in all languages the live stream was offered in:

    English
    German
    French
    Brazilian Portuguese
    Italian

Personal Bests are back & New languages added

And the last two pieces of news from us for now: today we're finally bringing back the missed by many Personal Bests feature, which received a complete overhaul. Plus we've just added two new languages - Romanian and Hungarian, which means that now theHunter can be played in 19 different languages. Thanks to our awesome translators for their extraordinary job, there is more to come!

Ok, we won't be holding you any longer, Val-des-Bois is calling! ;)

Happy hunting!

notes.title: Status Update 11th September 2014
notes.notes:
Howdy hunters,

Welcome to our weekly status update. Things in the office are going well, Calle has been settling in and has already started to dig into the much missed Personal Bests feature. Hopefully he’ll be able to find a better way to implement this functionality and bring it back to us soon.

Thank you for the feedback

Thank you everyone who have completed our feature survey, there were some interesting insights and we’ll be working on implementing them into our future roadmap. As promised, we randomly picked three respondents from all people who have replied to the survey and added 1000em$ to their accounts. Here is the lucky trio: Cashet, Jeff1963, restor104. Congratulations!

The new reserve has got its name

Thanks for all the name suggestions you’ve shared on 20 forum pages, some of them were really brilliant. We went through all of them and in the end settled on this gem we really liked: Val-des-Bois. It is pronounced /val des bwah/ and, loosely translated from French, means ”a wood valley”. We thought that both the melody and the meaning suit the new reserve and other EHR names very nicely. Our special thanks and appreciation goes to the player named [b]Haldur who has suggested this beautiful idea: congratulations, your name has now been recorded in the chronicles of theHunter ;)

The secrets of Val-des-Bois

As you might remember, we’ve mentioned that the new reserve will come with a couple of surprises. For starters, there of course will be a new animal living there, more on this in our next status update, but feel free to place your bets. Another surprise and a totally different game design feature was dictated by the mountain nature of the new reserve, and namely, to access certain particularly steep areas in Val-des-Bois you’ll have to climb! The ability to climb will come with special gear and some hazards, naturally associated with this kind of activity. More details will come later, for now here is the sneak preview of the climbing with Robin testing the new mode and animations (please note that this is still very much work in progress):

Deployable hunting tower

Today we released a new item – a deployable hunting tower which has been a popular community request. The hunting tower is different from the majority of our items in that you can not buy it in the store. These towers can only be obtained (for free) when buying selected types of memberships and membership bundles. The good news is that all existing members holding 6 or 12-month memberships, purchased via our website and Steam, got their first hunting tower automatically for free. For more details please check yesterday’s game update and the item description.

See you next week,

Happy hunting!

notes.title: Status Update 4th September 2014
notes.notes:
Hey hunters,

Summer is officially over, so is the Summer Fiesta event. The participation and feedback were amazing, great! The most challenging bonus mission was completed by as many as 140 hunters, who have become the proud holders of the diamond stag trophy. Well done everyone, more events to come!

It looks like you have been enjoying hunting the reindeer. Our apologies for the small hiccups right after the reindeer release that were causing game crashes for some players. Hopefully it didn't spoil the reindeer experience too much.

The work on the new, yet nameless, reserve continues as we approach the final stage. Speaking of the name, we have received tons of excellent suggestions and the team is having a hard time picking the best and most suitable one, plus all of us each have our own favourites. This means you still have time to submit your name suggestion if you have a one in a million idea.

Huge thanks to everyone who filled in our survey. Your input is invaluable. If you haven't found 5 minutes to do it yet – you have a couple of days left to do it and take part in our em$ draw before the survey closes on September 7th.

Today we released a premium version of the popular .308 revolver with the nostalgic name ”Highwayman”. Check it out, it looks like a piece of art.

From good to great news; today we're happy to introduce our new team member Calle who has just joined our backend team and will be working together with Emil on the code behind theHunter web. Read his intro and give him a proper welcome!


Hi there,

My name is Calle and I've just joined Expansive World, where I will work on our backend systems.

I'm originally from a tiny village on the eastern border of Sweden, between Småland and Östergötland, called Skeppsgården. I moved to Stockholm when I was 16 to study multimedia with the vision of becoming a game developer. As it turned out, the school was more about motion graphics, 3D design and the web. I tried all of them but got stuck with web development as that was the most "programmy" option.

Since then I worked as a web developer for a couple of years, studied at KTH Royal Institute of Technology, worked with 'Smart-TV' systems and only now, after 17 years, I'm finally in the business I aimed for when I was a pimply teenager.

I usually spend my free time with my girlfriend, my friends and my family. I'm into GeoCaching, watching TV-series and brewing beer.

Calle has already had his induction by fire into theHunter team, or to be more precise, induction by yellow paint balls. Yesterday our team went playing paintball to the woods of Stockholm, and here is a little photo report for you of this fun but quite happening.

See you in the woods, happy hunting!

notes.title: Status Update 28th August 2014
notes.notes:
Hi hunters, it's status update time!

Reindeer is here

As we announced in the game update, the herd of reindeer is now migrating through Hemmeldal, shaking their majestic antlers all over the area.

Here are some gameplay notes for you to keep in mind: The herd is broken up into smaller groups which cross over the borders, move across the reserve and cross the border again, leaving Hemmeldal. The game mechanic is similar to that of the waterfowl. If a reindeer is injured, the migratory behaviour gets cancelled to prevent it from being out of reach of the hunter.

Hunting reindeer is different from other deer species. They are always on the move, stopping only to feed. This will make spotting and stalking easier if players cooperate: by helping each other, players can pinpoint the reindeer and relay the information to other players who can get ready to give the animal a warm welcome.

Reindeer also are less attracted by callers. However, using an antler rattle will attract males looking for trouble.

New reserve sneak preview

The new Alpine reserve is slowly emerging and today we're ready to share some screenshots with you. Please bear in mind that the work is ongoing, and some things are subject to change.

You can see the screenshots on our blog:

Once again, we'd like to ask for your ideas and inspiration when it comes to naming the new reserve. It has become a great theHunter tradition to come up with reserves' names with the collaborative help of the community (Hirschfelden was initially a suggestion by community member MonacoSteve and Rougarou Bayou was brought up by player Mills), and we're happy to continue with it. Your name suggestions must reflect the soul and nature of the new reserve as well as fit nicely all the other geographical names in the EHR. Your suggestions are very welcome in this thread.

User survey

It's been a while since we ran a player survey, and with all new players having joined us following the Steam launch, we thought it's time to do it again. As usual, we're asking for your help to set priorities for the future development of the game, but please do not make assumptions of the future content and features, based solely on the fact that they were mentioned in the survey.

The survey is up and running and will be open until September 7th midnight CEST. You can only participate once. You can choose to remain anonymous or fill in your theHunter name, in the latter case you will automatically take part in our em$ draw, during which we will randomly choose three players who have completed the survey and will add 1000 em$ to their accounts. Please note that even if you let us know your name, the information you provide will not be stored with your account details, shared, sold, distributed or used in any other way that may harm you.

Complete the survey

Happy reindeer hunting!

notes.title: Status Update 21st August 2014
notes.notes:
Hello Hunters,

In this status update: news about the EW team, information about the upcoming reserve and the new animal revealed, so read on!

On the hunt for an awesome frontend developer

Sadly, our backend developer Adam and frontend developer Herman have left Expansive Worlds for other adventures, which means that we are short on the web staff at the moment and things might require additional time to get fixed and updated. A new backend developer is already on his way, but we’re still on the lookout for a talented frontend developer to fill in Herman’s shoes. If you know someone who might fit the role, send them our way! Here is the detailed job description.

It’s gonna be mountains!

The work on the new reserve continues and we’re happy to tell you that it’s going to be an Alps inspired reserve. It will feature ample meadows, shady mountains, lavish spruce and a sparkling creek. Once we’re ready, we’ll share more details and some screenshots with you, for now just rest assured that the new reserve will come with a couple of surprises.

You know Dasher and Dancer…

Here comes the most exciting piece – the mysterious new species. Well, not that mysterious, since hundreds of people hit the nail on the head with their guesses. Yes, it’s a reindeer and it’ll come to Hemmeldal. Here you can see some screenshots of this gorgeous boy for you to savour, please bear in mind that it’s still being tweaked and some minor changes might be added before the actual release.

Sneak peek competition – Winners

We’ve received 280 correct answers to our the competition to guess the animal and reserve. Much more people guessed right, but they didn’t qualify for one or another reason (their guesses were either not submitted in the specified forum thread, or after the deadline, or mentioned only the animal, or made several guesses). We accepted both ”caribou” and ”reindeer” as correct replies, because those are two names for the same species used in different areas of the world. Since Hemmeldal is set on our European inspired continent, we decided to use the local name ”reindeer”. Here are the names of the 10 winners, chosen randomly from 280 people, who will receive a new reindeer rattler caller, a large bottle of scent eliminator and, if applicable, a one-week license to hunt the very same.


 The Herring
 Rabbitfriend
 EclipseStar
 extremebowhunter12
 Villkatta
 ItzCriscco
 Renier Cronje
 Lateralus
 Charlie2299
 SeeDoe


If your name in game is different from your forum name please contact Alena.

That’s it from us for today, let us know what you think about the looks of the reindeer in the discussion thread linked to below.

Happy hunting!

The work on the new reserve continues and we’re happy to tell you that it’s going to be an Alps inspired reserve. It will feature ample meadows, shady mountains, lavish spruce and a sparkling creek. Once we’re ready, we’ll share more details and some screenshots with you, for now just rest assured that the new reserve will come with a couple of surprises.

You know Dasher and Dancer…

Here comes the most exciting piece – the mysterious new species. Well, not that mysterious, since hundreds of people hit the nail on the head with their guesses. Yes, it’s a reindeer and it’ll come to Hemmeldal. Here you can see some screenshots of this gorgeous boy for you to savour, please bear in mind that it’s still being tweaked and some minor changes might be added before the actual release.

Sneak peek competition – Winners

We’ve received 280 correct answers to our the competition to guess the animal and reserve. Much more people guessed right, but they didn’t qualify for one or another reason (their guesses were either not submitted in the specified forum thread, or after the deadline, or mentioned only the animal, or made several guesses). We accepted both ”caribou” and ”reindeer” as correct replies, because those are two names for the same species used in different areas of the world. Since Hemmeldal is set on our European inspired continent, we decided to use the local name ”reindeer”. Here are the names of the 10 winners, chosen randomly from 280 people, who will receive a new reindeer rattler caller, a large bottle of scent eliminator and, if applicable, a one-week license to hunt the very same.


 The Herring
 Rabbitfriend
 EclipseStar
 extremebowhunter12
 Villkatta
 ItzCriscco
 Renier Cronje
 Lateralus
 Charlie2299
 SeeDoe


If your name in game is different from your forum name please contact Alena.

That’s it from us for today, let us know what you think about the looks of the reindeer in the discussion thread linked to below.

Happy hunting!

notes.title: Status Update 23rd July 2014
notes.notes:
Hello hunters,

There was no usual status update last week, since we communicated all the releases and changes in the game updates, so here comes a double portion of news from us.

What's cooking?

Half of the EW team is still out of office, but the work on the new species is moving along nicely, albeit slowly. With all the work to be done down the line, we are not ready to tell you the release date yet. I know that most of you are waiting impatiently to learn what it is, but it is still too early for us to reveal. The first drafts of the new animal look stunning, and I can't wait to share some screenshots with you at a later point.

There is yet another new thing we've started working on, which is a far more colossal project than a new species and which is, hopefully, will get you even more excited. Namely, for the last weeks our art team has been busy working on the new reserve, yes! We can't share yet what kind of terrain it is or when it'll be released, but the work is pretty much in the inception phase right now. According to our art guys, the new reserve is going to be ”glorious”, and it's something we all are looking forward to.

Known issues

Because of the holiday season, there has been a backlog of mostly web-related issues, which have been an annoyance for lots of players, including 'Previous competitions' not working properly, avatars disappearing etc. You can find the complete list here. Once our backend staff is back to the office this week, they'll be looking to start working on them. We apologize to those of you who have been affected and had to wait for those problems to be resolved!

Turkey hunting revamp

Today one of our most unpopular, although unjustly, species has received an overhaul, which will hopefully help it to rise to theHunter stardom. To be specific, we've released decoys, a new ”locator” caller and introduced some tweaks to the bird's AI; the details can be found in Björn's release notes. Go give the new equipment a try and let us know your feedback!

That's it from us for today, happy hunting!

notes.title: Status Update 10th July 2014
notes.notes:
Howdy Hunters,

Here comes a small batch of updates from us:

Football Jamboree – Awarding prizes

We know that those of you who have bought Jamboree caps can’t wait for the end of the event to lay their hands on the shotgun with gold engraving. Although the event ends on July 14th, the shotguns and trophies will be awarded to those who qualify two days later, on July 16th. We sincerely apologize for this short delay, but the people who will be issuing awards are on holidays until then.

Known issues

A bit more on the topic of holidays; there are a number of bugs and small issues waiting to be fixed until people responsible for that area of the game are back to the office. These include disappearing avatars, not being able to ban members from multiplayer games, problems with buying memberships via Steam experienced by some players and a couple of others. We’re asking for your patience when it comes to those things, we’ll do our best to fix everything once we’re in full power again.

New community feature – Tip of the week

Today we’re launching a new community feature – Tip of the week. If you have a helpful, insightful, hilarious or even just unique tip, share it with the community in this nomination thread or tweet it with the hashtag #thehuntertip. If someone else’s great tip has been an invaluable help in your hunting adventures, feel free to nominate it as well. The best tips will be featured on our communication channels on a weekly basis and collected in theHunter tips database for everyone’s use.

That’s all from us for today.

Happy hunting!

notes.title: Status Update 3rd July 2014
notes.notes:
Hello all good hunters,

Here are some bits and pieces from the EW team, heavily undermined by summer holidays:


José received over 60 questions to his AMA, it took him a while to reply to all of them, but the answers are finally here: he has shared some animation tips and tricks, the portfolio video he used to apply for a job at EW and even a chat up line in Swedish ;) In short – worth a read!

The programmers have been busy fixing bugs (for more details check the game update from yesterday) and it looks like they finally (not to speak too soon) managed to resolve the persistent ”spinning camera” issue which was driving the community crazy and which we were not able to reproduce for more than a month. The breakthrough became possible thanks to your input, and in particular thanks to the discussion in this thread. Special kudos go to the community member Raptor02 who kindly provided his account for testing purposes and owing to this Andrés and Danny managed to get a lead on this bug.We know that there are still some bugs in the game and we continue working on locating and squashing them.
         
We’d also like to thank our brilliant team of translators, we hope you know how much we appreciate what you’re doing for theHunter! Due to your hard work, the game is now fully localized into German, Brazilian Portuguese, Finnish and Norwegian and almost completely into Italian, Portuguese and French, with 22 more languages coming. Today our special gratitude is sent to MonacoSteve (German team), XandyBecas (Brazilian Portuguese), Sannas and Lapehunter (Finnish), Arnstein86 and Skogseide (Norwegian), Cireme and mmmick60 (French), lisarob (Italian) and JackRbbt (Romanian) for their consistent and active input, you’ve been doing a huge favour to your fellow countrymen hunters.

If you want to join our translation team, we are always on the lookout for people who are native speakers of different languages and can keep secrets (all our translators work under an NDA, since they get access to information about yet unreleased stuff). Right now we especially need the help of people who speak Dutch, Danish, Portuguese, Russian, Swedish, Hungarian, Czech and Slovak on a native level, but we’d love adding more flags to theHunter website, so even if your language is not supported yet, you are welcome to apply by sending Alena a message.
         
Our Football Jamboree is moving into an exciting phase with quarter finals starting tomorrow and only 8 teams (and caps) left. If you haven’t made up your mind yet – it’s about the time to grab a cap or two to secure your ”golden” shotgun.
         
Speaking about awesome shotguns, starting from today the much anticipated ‘12 GA Blaser F3 Game O/U Shotgun – Custom Grade V‘ is finally available in the store. Enjoy! 


Good hunting all!

notes.title: Status Update
notes.notes:
Hello Hunters,

This update will be short again, since a part of the team is already enjoying their holidays and the office is unusually quiet. The rest of team continues their work on the new species, which has already started to resemble a real animal. It has been speculated in the community about the new-arrival-to-be and some people were spot on about who it is and what reserve it is going to live in here.

Steam reviews

A lot of you have raised concerns about the reviews that theHunter has received in a couple of weeks after we launched on Steam. The ratio of negative vs. positive ones is not that great indeed, however, it doesn’t reflect in our stats and a growing number of new and active players. We’ve of course been monitoring and evaluating all the reviews and it looks like people are mostly negative about the business model and the Free To Play label, whereas only a small percentage find the game itself bad or boring. Although it’s reassuring, we appreciate and take into consideration all the feedback we receive.

It is often the case, that people who like the game leave reviews less actively, whereas people who don’t like it are quicker to raise their voice. If you do like theHunter, we are asking you to support us by leaving a review, because right now it looks like the reviews create a rather distorted picture of community’s feelings, when compared to the data we’ve received from the surveys and player stats.

Ask Me Anything with José

This week we’re hosting another Ask Me Anything session in our official forum, this time with our lead animator José Diaz. Animal and weapon animations are brought up frequently, so here is your chance to ask something you’ve been wondering about.

Jose’s AMA thread will be unlocked for 48 hours, starting at 12 p.m. CEST on June 27th. All the questions will be moderated and supervised by the moderation team, the standard AMA rules apply.

Happy hunting!

notes.title: Status Update June 4th 2014
notes.notes:
Hello Hunters,

Welcome to our status update and the biggest news of this week is that, finally...

We're rolling out on Steam!

Some of you will probably not notice any difference, whereas die-hard Steam fans will rejoice, but we are very happy to be able to bring theHunter to more people and excited to see what this milestone means for us. On Monday we started a ”soft launch”, it means that we've been gradually adding new countries while monitoring our servers to make sure they're coping with the sudden player increase.

If you're located in one of the countries where we've already launched (most European countries at this very moment, but the list grows as we speak, so we'd recommend you to check now and then), you can now find theHunter in the Steam store, add it to your Library and start playing. The first time you start the game in Steam, you will get an option to create a new theHunter account or connect using a pre-exisiting one. Once your Steam and theHunter accounts have been connected, you won't need to enter your login details again (when starting from Steam).

There have been some concerns expressed about what this change would bring to the game and how the ”Steam” version of theHunter would integrate with the ”old school” one. To put everyone at ease, there won't be two different versions, all your account information will be automatically available on Steam and vice versa. When you start the game via Steam, you'll be able to play exactly like you're used to via the new launcher.

We'll really appreciate if you find some time to support us and leave a review on Steam. To be able to do it, you need to have theHunter in your library and have played it for at least 5 minutes.

Bug fixing

Andrés, Danny and Robin devoted this week solely to bugs fixing, so for the last three days they have been trying to locate, reproduce and resolve bugs in game. The plan is to run such bug fixing weeks on a regular basis. However, please keep in mind that it can take the programmers up to a couple of days to find and reproduce one single bug, as it is for example the case with the "spinning” issue, which has been discussed a lot recently.

That's all from us for today, make sure to check our update next week, as we're going to announce a new event.

Happy hunting!
